blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In-context learning (ICL) lets a pretrained language model perform a task specified by demonstrations in its prompt, with no parameter updates. With arbitrary labels the model must acquire a mapping it cannot have memorized, so the learning happens within a single forward pass. Prior work found candidate parts but not how they compose. We give the composition for few-shot sentence classification with arbitrary labels in three 3-4B-parameter transformers. The model implements a key-value memory over label-token positions: each label token's residual stream encodes the label's identity, and middle-layer attention heads write into it the class of the preceding demonstration as its key. At the query, upper-layer heads match the query's class against the stored keys and copy out the matching labels. An early-layer signal encoding whether any label has repeated gates this readout; in its absence the readers attend to the start of the prompt and no label is favored. A separate set of heads suppresses the most recently seen label. Each step is established causally by activation patching, head ablations against random-head baselines, and steering with the model's own signals. A softmax model of the readout with two constants per head, fit on one prompt distribution, predicts another. The computation is conserved across the three models, the named heads alone reproduce the behaviour, and a transformer trained from scratch grows the same parts. The circuit transfers to semantic concepts and to labels with meaning, and the same parts, with a causal gate, appear from 0.6B to 8B in one family and survive instruction tuning. ICL in this setting is a gated associative lookup built from a few identifiable component types, traced causally from demonstrations to prediction.
blocks.zh: in-context学习(ICL)让一个预先训练的语言模型在它的即时执行演示指定的任务,没有参数更新. 有了任意的标签,模型必须获得一个它无法记住的映射,所以学习发生在一个单一的前传中. 先前的工作找到了候选部分,但没有找到其构成方式。 我们给出了几发的句子的成分分类,在三个3-4B参数变压器中带有任意的标签. 该模型在标签脚本位置上执行一个键值内存:每个标签符的剩余流编码标签的身份,中层关注头将上一个演示的类写入其中,作为它的关键. 在查询时,上层头像与存储的密钥对应查询类,并复制匹配的标签. 早期的信号编码, 以定义任何标签是否重复了此读出闸门; 在它不存在的情况下, 阅读器会注意提示的开始, 没有标签 。 一套单独的头来压制最近看到的标签. 每一步都通过激活补丁,头部与随机头基线相对应,并用模型本身的信号向导来因果确定. 一个读取的软马克斯模型,每头有两个常数,适合一个即时分布,预测另一个. 计算被保存在三个模型中,被命名的头单独复制行为,一个从零开始训练的变压器会生长相同的部分. 电路向语义概念和带有意义的标签转移,具有因果门的相同部分在一个家族中从0.6B到8B出现,幸存指令调谐. 在这个背景下的ICL是一个由几个可识别的组件类型所构建的门式的关联性搜索,从演示到预测都有因果追溯.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Show a base language model a dozen lines like these, The soup was cold and the waiter rude -> bar A gorgeous evening with old friends -> foo … I would not go back to that place -> and it answers bar . Nothing in pretraining taught it that foo means a pleasant evening or that bar means a bad meal. The model worked that out from the prompt, in a single forward pass, without any change to its weights. This is few-shot in-context learning ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , one of the abilities that turned language models into general-purpose tools. Labelling sentences is its simplest form, and it is the form we study here; instructions, long-form tasks and binding among many classes are outside the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh: 显示一个基础语言模型 十二行这样的, 汤很冷,服务生很粗鲁 -- -- 与老朋友一起过着美好的夜晚, 我不会回到那个地方, 预训中没有任何东西教它,foo意味着一个愉快的夜晚,或者那个酒吧意味着一个糟糕的晚餐。 模型从一个瞬间, 在一个单一的前进通道, 没有任何改变它的重量。 这是少数镜头的文字学习(Brown等人,2020年),是将语言模型转化为通用工具的能力之一. 标签句是最简单的形式,也是我们在这里研究的形式;许多类中的指示,长式任务和约束不属于本文的范围.

blocks.en: Several pieces of the mechanism are already known. Induction heads copy the token that followed an earlier occurrence of the current token ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Work on task vectors and function vectors ( Hendel et al., 2023 ; Todd et al., 2023 ) has shown that a handful of heads carry a compact description of the demonstrated task to the query. Label tokens are where task information accumulates ( Cho et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , and the recency bias of in-context learning has been traced to query–key similarity with label positions ( Yu & Ananiadou, 2024 ) . What has been missing is an account of how these pieces fit together into one working algorithm. It was not known exactly what gets written at the label tokens, or on which side of attention it is later read; which heads read it, and what switches that read on and off; how the result reaches the logits; or which of the parts are single heads one can name and which exist only as populations that act in sum.
blocks.zh: 该机制的若干部分已经众所周知。 上岗头抄袭了先期出现现代币后的代币(Olsson等人,2022年). 关于任务矢量和函数矢量的工作(Hendel等人,2023年;Todd等人,2023年)表明,少数头头对被证明的任务进行了紧凑的描述,以便查询。 标记符号是任务信息累积的地方(Cho等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2024年;Hu等人,2025年),而内文学习的回溯偏差被追溯到查询-键与标签位置的相似性(Yu & Ananiadou,2024年). 所缺少的就是这些片段是如何组合成一个工作算法的。 不清楚在标签符号上写了什么,或者它后来读到的是哪一边的注意力;哪个头读了它,哪个开关读了读了读了读了读了;结果是如何到达日志的;或者哪个部分是单头,一个人可以指名道姓,哪个部分只作为总和行动的种群存在。

blocks.en: This paper gives such an account for two-class label retrieval and function selection, on invented-word and natural labels, with up to twelve demonstrations, in three base models of three to four billion parameters: Qwen3-4B, SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.2-3B. In the field’s terms we describe a circuit and the algorithm it implements. Figure 2 draws the circuit, Figure 3 lays it out along the layers, and Figure 1 places it on a single prompt.
blocks.zh: 本文在发明的文字和自然标签上为双类标签检索和函数选择提供了这样的说明,在3至40亿参数的3个基本模型中最多有12个演示:Qune3-4B,SmolLM3-3B和Llama-3.2-3B. 我们用这个字段来描述一个电路及其执行的算法。 图2绘制了电路,图3沿各层铺设,图1将其放在一个单一的提示上.

blocks.en: In brief, the model turns its demonstrations into a key–value memory inside the prompt. Each label token becomes a slot whose value is the identity of the label and whose key is the class of the sentence it followed. The key is deposited by about twenty attention heads in the middle layers, which read the sentence and write its class into the label token’s residual stream (K-composition in the sense of Elhage et al. 2021 ). When the model reaches the query it computes the class of the new sentence, and about ninety heads in the upper layers compare that class with the slot keys through an ordinary softmax over positions and copy out the labels whose keys match. These readers are, in effect, induction heads keyed on a class.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,模型将演示转化为提示内的关键-价值记忆。 每个标签符成为一个槽,其值是标签的身份,其键是它所遵循的句子的类别. 键由大约20个注意力头在中间层沉积,它们读出句子,并将其类写入标签符的残余流(K-组分,意为Elhage等人,2021年). 当模型到达查询时,它计算出新句子的类,上层大约90个头通过一个普通的软max在位置上比较该类与槽键,并复制出其键匹配的标签. 这些读者实际上是在课堂上按键的诱导头.

blocks.en: The read is gated. Early in the network, duplicate-token heads register whether any label has appeared twice, and that information is pooled into a single direction in the residual stream at the query. The direction lowers the logit that the readers assign to the attention sink at position zero. When no label repeats, the sink wins the softmax and the readers return nothing in particular. We call this outcome the null action. It follows from the softmax itself, since attention has to go somewhere, and the sink is where these heads put the attention they do not spend on the slots. Finally, a population of about two dozen heads writes against whichever label the model saw most recently. These are negative heads in the sense of Wang et al. (2022) and McDougall et al. (2023) . We call them brakes, because removing them nearly triples the margin and leaves the model biased toward the most recent label.
blocks.zh: 读诵已门. 在网络的早期,重复的敲头会记录任何标签是否两次出现,在查询时将信息集合到剩余流的单个方向. 方向会降低阅读器在零位置分配给注意力沉积的对数. 当没有标签重复时,水槽会赢得软max,读者则不会特别返回. 我们称这一结果无效。 它从软顶本身产生,因为注意力必须去某个地方,而水槽就是这些头把注意力不花在槽上的地方. 最后,大约二十几个人头写着反对模型最近看到的标签。 这些是王等人(2022年)和麦克杜格尔等人(2023年)意义上的负面头部. 我们称它们为刹车,因为移除它们 几乎是比边距的三倍, 并且让模型偏向于最近的标签。

blocks.en: Every step of this account rests on an intervention with a matched control. We build pairs of prompts that are identical token for token except in one span, where we change one sentence, one label or the query, and we move activations from one member of the pair into the other, head by head, group by group or position by position. We knock out heads and compare against random heads from the same layers. We steer the residual stream along directions at the strength the model itself uses and compare against random directions of the same norm. Every head set chosen on one draw of prompts is confirmed on a fresh draw. Where the model concentrates a function in a few heads we name them. Where it spreads a function over many, we describe the population by the direction it reads or writes, and show that this direction matters more than a random subspace of the same dimension. We also account for the answer exactly. On each prompt, the contributions of all heads and MLPs to the answer logit add up to the model’s own logit to within 0.05 nats.
blocks.zh: 这一账户的每一步骤都取决于具有相应控制的干预。 我们构建一对是同一种代号的提示,除了一个跨度,我们改变一个句子,一个标签或查询,我们把激活从一个成对的成员移动到另一个成员,逐个头,逐组或按位置移动. 我们敲掉头 和同一层的随机头比较 我们用模型本身的强度 引导残流沿着方向前进 并与同一规范的随机方向进行比较 在一个提示图上选择的每个头集都会在新画上确认. 当模型将一个功能集中在几个头的地方时,我们给它们取名。 当它将一个函数传播到很多地方时,我们用它读或写的方向来描述人口,并表明这个方向比同一个维度的随机子空间更重要. 我们也负责确切的答案。 在每次提示时,所有头头和MLP对答对数的贡献等于模型本身的登录数在0.05纳特以内。

blocks.en: Two results surprised us. The first is that the read follows a simple law. The attention each reader pays to the matching slots is described by a softmax expression in the number of matching slots, the total number of slots and the null logit. It has three constants per head, of which two are identifiable, because two of them enter only through their sum. Constants fitted on twelve-demonstration prompts predict a regime with one slot per class that was never used in fitting, in both Qwen and Llama. The same constants fail on longer prompts. When we looked at why, we found that each head’s attention to the sink, and its total attention to the matching slots, are roughly fixed properties of the head, so adding matching slots divides a fixed budget among them.
blocks.zh: 两个结果让我们吃惊。 第一种说法是,阅读遵循简单的法律。 每个阅读器对匹配时段的注意,在匹配时段数,总时段数和无效的登录数中以软马克思表达. 其每头有3个常数,其中2个可识别,因为其中2个仅通过它们的总和进入. 安装在12个演示提示上的常数预示着一个每类有一个插槽的系统,在Quen和Llama都从未使用过。 相同的常数在更长的提示上失败. 当我们审视原因时,我们发现每个头对水槽的关注,以及它对匹配槽的全部关注,都是头部的大致固定属性,所以加入匹配槽就可以在它们之间分配一个固定的预算.

blocks.en: The second surprise concerns why so many of the components are populations. A single reader already separates the two classes in its attention pattern, so the model is not spreading the work because individual heads lack the signal. What individual heads lack is output gain. No head contributes more than 0.2 nats of logit directly, so a 1.3-nat answer is a sum over at least seven heads. (A 1.3-nat change between two prompts needs at least four, since a head’s contribution can change sign.)
blocks.zh: 第二个惊喜是,为什么如此之多的组成部分是人口。 一个单一的读者已经在它的注意力模式中将两个班级分开,所以这个模型并没有传播作品,因为单个头部缺乏信号. 个人头部缺乏的是产出收益。 没有头直接贡献超过0.2纳特的对数,所以1.3纳特的答案是至少7个头以上的总和. (两个提示之间的1.3-nat变化至少需要四个,因为头部的贡献可以改变标志。)

blocks.en: Sections 3 to 8 follow the computation from the slot, through the read (Section 4 ), the gate (Section 5 ) and the query code (Section 6 ), to the readers and brakes (Section 7 ) and the final logits. Section 9 asks which parts of the account any transformer would need and which are left to training, and tests the account in two further models and across training checkpoints. Sections 10 and 11 carry the circuit to natural concepts and word labels, to four model sizes and to an instruction-tuned model, and Section 12 builds it twice, once by hand and once by training a small transformer from scratch. After related work (Section 13 ), Section 14 sets out what the account does not cover, including the predictions that did not hold, and what we think it implies more broadly.
blocks.zh: 第3节至第8节按照从时间档、读数(第4节)、门(第5节)和查询码(第6节)到读数和制动(第7节)和最后对数的计算。 第9节询问账户中哪些部分需要任何变压器,哪些部分留待培训,并用另外两种模式和跨越培训检查站对账户进行测试。 第10节和第11节将电路带入自然概念和文字标签,达到四个模型大小和一个指导调制的模型,第12节将电路两期建设,一次是手动建造,一次是从零开始训练一个小变压器. 在相关工作(第13节)之后,第14节规定了账户没有涵盖的内容,包括没有包含的预测,以及我们认为它意味着更广泛的内容。

blocks.en: Figure 1: One twelve-demonstration prompt, stage by stage. Columns are tokens (sentences s i s_{i} , arrows, labels and the query q q ) and rows are layers of Qwen3-4B. Each coloured block marks the tokens and layers where a stage acts: the duplicate detectors and the encoder early on, the writers into the label tokens in the middle layers, and then, at the query arrow, the query code, the gate, the readers, the brakes and the readout band. Later sections give the intervention behind each block.
blocks.zh: 图1:按阶段分列的一个12个演示提示。 列为符(sentences s i s_{i}),箭头,标签和查询q q q ),行为Qwen3-4B层. 每个彩色块标记一个舞台作用的标志和层: 早期的重复探测器和编码器,中层的编剧进入标签标志,然后在查询箭头,查询码,闸门,阅读器,制动器和读取带. 后面的章节给出每个街区后面的干预.

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: Every prompt in the paper is a list of demonstrations, one per line, written sentence -> label , followed by a query sentence and an arrow. The model’s next token is its answer. We use four prompt sets, which we call batteries. The concept battery has six demonstrations, three per class, on sentence axes such as topic (animals against food), sentiment, language (English against Spanish) and question against statement, with invented-word labels ( foo / bar , quil / zorp ) and natural ones. The concept12 battery is the same with twelve demonstrations, six per class. The slotgate battery has four demonstrations and comes in token-identical pairs. In one member of each pair every label appears twice, and in the other every label appears once, so the two differ only in whether labels repeat. The manyclass battery has two to six classes with one or more demonstrations each and arbitrary single-token labels. Appendix G shows one verbatim prompt from each battery, and Appendix A gives further details. Every label except zorp is a single token in all three tokenizers; for a two-token label, the first token carries the key.
blocks.zh: 纸上的每个提示都是演示列表,每行一个,写句->标签,后面是查询句和箭头. 该模型的下一个标志是它的答案。 我们使用四个快速装置, 我们称之为电池。 概念电池有6种演示,每类有3种,关于句子轴,如主题(动物反对食物),情绪,语言(英语反对西班牙语)和问题反对语句,有发明的单词标签(foo / bar, quil / zorp)和自然的标签. 概念12电池与12个演示相同,每班6个. 槽门电池有4个演示,是同一种符号的对。 在每对标签中的一个成员中,每个标签出现两次,在另一个成员中,每个标签出现一次,所以这两个成员仅在标签是否重复出现上有所不同. 多级电池有2至6个级,每个级有一个或多个演示以及任意的单键标签. 附 录 G显示每个电池的1个逐字记录提示,附录A提供进一步的细节。 除了Zorp之外,每个标签都是所有三个代币符中的单个代币;对于一个双键标签,第一个代币带有密钥.

blocks.en: We score a prompt by its margin, the log-probability of the correct label minus that of the other label, each scored over its full token sequence. A positive margin means the model prefers the right answer, and a margin of 2 nats means it prefers it by a factor of about seven. The effect of an intervention is the change in margin it causes, paired prompt by prompt with the intact run, and every effect is reported with a 95% interval from a paired bootstrap over prompts (4000 resamples). When we say that knocking out a head set “costs − 0.74 -0.74 nats”, we mean that it lowers the margin by that much on average.
blocks.zh: 我们按其比值得分,正确标签的对数概率减去其他标签的对数概率,每个标签的得分都超过其全部符号序列。 正差表示模型偏爱正确的答案,2 nats的比值表示它偏爱它约7倍. 干预的效果是其导致的差值变化,迅速与完好无缺的运行进行配对,每一次效应报告的时间间隔为95%,与双靴子比拖曳(4 000个复标)。 当我们说敲出一个头套“成本−0.74-0.74纳特”,我们的意思是,它平均把比值降低了多少。

blocks.en: Most of our interventions use twins: two prompts that are identical token for token except inside one span. We use five kinds. The class-flipped twin replaces one demonstration’s sentence with a sentence of the other class. The same-class twin replaces it with a different sentence of the same class and the same length; its answer should not change, and it serves as a control. The label exchange swaps foo and bar everywhere. The other-class query replaces the query sentence with one of the other class. The unique-label rewrite replaces each repeated label with a fresh one. Because twins line up token for token, we can take any activation from one and place it into the other at the same position, and ask how much of the difference between the twins that one activation carries. We call this a handoff.
blocks.zh: 我们的大多数发言都使用双胞胎:除了一个跨度之外,两个提示是相同的象征。 我们使用五种。 班级双胞胎将一个演示的句子替换为另一个类的句子. 同级双人代之以同级同长的不同句子;其答案不应改变,起到控制的作用. 标签交换 互换foo和酒吧。 其他类的查询用一个类取代查询句. 独有的标签重写将每个重复的标签替换为新标签. 因为双胞胎排成一排作为一号, 我们可以从一个开始任何激活, 把它放在另一个位置, 问一个激活携带的双胞胎之间的区别有多大。 我们称之为交割。

blocks.en: Alongside handoffs we use three other operations. To knock out a head we mean-ablate it, replacing its output by its mean over the battery; this removes what the head writes without setting it to zero. To steer , we add a direction to the residual stream at the query arrow at the dose the model itself uses, taken to be the difference in projection between twins, and compare the result against a random direction of the same norm. To hold a component, we fix it at its intact value while a handoff runs upstream of it, which tells us whether the upstream effect passes through that component. All of these are forward hooks on the HuggingFace implementations of the models, run in bfloat16 on one H100. We also record per-head attention patterns at chosen layers, the direct contribution of every head and MLP to the answer logit, and projections of the residual stream onto fitted directions. Table 1 collects the terms we use for the parts of the circuit and for these operations.
blocks.zh: 除了交割外,我们用另外三个行动。 要击倒一个头,我们是指将其缩写,用它相对于电池的平均值来取代它的输出;这可以去除头部所写的,而不设为零. 为了引导,我们在模型本身使用的剂量的查询箭头上添加一个方向,被认为是双胞胎之间投影的区别,并将结果与同一规范的随机方向进行比较. 为了持有一个部件,我们把它固定在它完好无损的价值上,而交接则在它的上游进行,这告诉我们上游效应是否穿过这个部件。 所有这些都是HuggingFace执行模型的前钩,在1架H100上以bfloat16运行. 我们还记录了选定层次的人均注意力图案、每个头和MLP对答对数的直接贡献,以及剩余流向适当方向的预测。 表1收集了我们在线路部件和这些操作中使用的术语.

blocks.en: Every named head set is compared with random sets of the same size drawn from the same layers, and every steering direction with a random direction of the same norm. Every set selected on one draw of prompts is confirmed on a fresh draw from the same pools with a different seed, and the numbers we lead with come from the fresh draw.
blocks.zh: 每个命名的头集都与从同一层抽取的大小相同的随机的组合进行对比,每个方向都与同一规范的随机方向进行对比. 每一组从一个抽图上选取的, 都从同一个有不同种子的池里的新抽图上确认, 而我们带的号码来自新抽图。

blocks.en: We study Qwen3-4B-Base (36 layers, 32 query heads, 8 key–value groups, QK-norm), SmolLM3-3B-Base (36 layers, 16 heads, 4 groups) and Llama-3.2-3B (28 layers, 24 heads, 8 groups), and we use intermediate checkpoints of OLMo-2 1B and 7B to study how the circuit emerges during training. blocks.en: Figure 2: The circuit for few-shot in-context learning in Qwen3-4B-Base. Prompt tokens run down the left (sentences S i S_{i} , labels L i L_{i} , the query Q Q and its arrow END). Boxes are classes of attention heads, with layer.head numbers beneath. Writer heads give each label token a key (the class of its sentence) alongside its value (the label). At END, reader heads match the query’s class against those keys and copy the matching labels, copier heads write the logits, and brake heads write against the most recent label. The gate g g , assembled by the pooling heads, opens the read by lowering the readers’ attention-sink logit (dashed). Sections 3 – 8 give the intervention behind each arrow.
blocks.zh: 图 2: Qwen3-4B-Base中数发内文学习的电路. 提示符运行在左侧( 句号 S i S_{i} , 标签 L i L_{i} , 查询 Q 及其箭头 END) 。 盒子是注意头类,有层层. 头数下. 写手头给每个标签符号一个键(其句子的类),连同其值(标签). 在 END 上, 读者头与查询类相对应, 复制匹配的标签, 复印机头写日志, Gg门由集合头组装,通过降低读者的注意力-沉积记录(dashed)打开读数. 第3–8节给出每个箭头背后的干预.

blocks.en: Figure 3: The same circuit laid out along the layers of Qwen3-4B-Base. The top lane shows what happens at the label tokens: duplicate-token heads mark a repeated label, and writers deposit the sentence’s class into the label’s residual stream, which makes it a slot with a value and a key. The bottom lane shows what happens at the query arrow: the encoder computes the query’s class, the pooled repeat signal g g lowers the readers’ sink logit, the readers match the query’s class against the slot keys and copy the matching values, and the readout band and late MLPs write the logits while the brakes write against the last label.
blocks.zh: 图3:沿Qune3-4B-Base层排列的同一电路. 上面的车道显示标签符号发生的情况:重复的敲头标记一个重复的标签,写作者将句子的等级存入标签的剩余流中,这使得它成为一个带有值和键的插槽. 下行显示查询箭头发生的情况:编码器计算查询的类,集合的重复信号g降低读者的沉积记录,读者将查询的类与槽键相匹配并复制匹配值,读出带和后期的MLP在制动器向上一个标签写时会写出日志.

blocks.en: Figure 4: The four main interventions, each drawn on the end of a 12-shot prompt. The red component is replaced or steered, and the output is read at END. (a) Sentence swap: the keys at a label token come from the twin in which that demonstration’s sentence belongs to the other class, so the slot’s key no longer matches its value. (b) Label swap: the values at the label token come from the twin with the labels exchanged. (c) Gate steering: the model’s own gate direction g g is added at END at its natural magnitude, before the reader layers, and we measure the readers’ attention to the sink and to the matching slots. (d) Query-code handoff: the outputs of the two query heads at END come from the twin whose query is of the other class; later attention outputs can be held fixed to test whether the effect passes through them.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 四项主要发言,每份发言都取自12镜头的快讯。 红色组件被替换或引导,输出在END读取. (a) 句子交换:标签标志上的键来自该演示句子属于另一类的双胞胎,因此该槽的键不再与其值相符。 (b) 标签互换:标签符上的值来自与标签互换的对子。 (c) 门向:模型本身的门向gg按其自然数量在END上加上,在读者层之前,我们测量读者对水槽和匹配槽的注意力。 (d) 查询码交接:END的两个查询头的产出来自其查询属于另一类的双胞胎;以后的注意输出可以固定,以测试效果是否通过.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Anatomy of a slot. The residual stream at a label token holds two things, which are read through two different matrices. The label’s identity comes from the token’s own embedding and the early layers, and is read by the readers’ W V W_{V} . The class of the preceding sentence is written in by middle-layer heads that attend back to the sentence, and is read by the readers’ W K W_{K} as the key that the query’s class is matched against.

blocks.en: By the time the model reaches the query, it needs two facts about each demonstration: which class its sentence belonged to, and which label followed it. Both end up in the same place, the residual stream of the label token. We call that residual a slot, because it behaves like one cell of a key–value memory (Figure 5 ). Its value is the identity of the label, and its key is the class of the sentence that came before it. The value and the key are read on different sides of attention, and two experiments, sketched in Figure 4 a–b, pull them apart.
blocks.zh: 当模型到达查询时,它需要关于每个演示的两个事实:它的句子属于哪个类别,哪个标签跟着它. 两者最终都在同一地点,即标签符号的残流. 我们称它为剩余槽,因为它的行为就像一个键-值记忆的细胞(图5). 它的价值是标签的特性,它的密钥是它之前的句子的类别. 数值和键在不同的关注面上被读取,在图4a-b中勾画出来的两个实验将它们拉开.

blocks.en: Take a prompt and swap foo and bar throughout, leaving every sentence in place. The right answer to the query is now the other label, and the model’s margin changes sign. To find which activations carry the flip, we patch the keys and values at the label tokens from the swapped prompt into the intact run. Patching them at every layer reproduces the flip exactly ( − 7.18 -7.18 nats in Qwen, − 5.55 -5.55 in SmolLM3, − 4.92 -4.92 in Llama), but that only checks the harness and says nothing about the model. Two prompts that differ only at the label tokens have identical inputs everywhere else, so replacing the label tokens’ keys and values at every layer makes every other position compute exactly what it computes in the swapped prompt. This is true of any transformer, by induction over layers (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 迅速取出一个 和交换的foo和酒吧, 留下每一个句子在原位。 查询的正确答案现在是另一个标签,模型的比值会改变符号. 为了找到哪个激活器携带翻转器,我们把标签符号上的密钥和值从交换的提示补到完好的运行中. 每一层的补丁都确切地复制翻转(Quen的−7.18-7.18纳特,SmolLM3的−5.55-5.55,Llama的−4.92-4.92),但这只检查了吊带,对模型一字不提。 只有标签符号上不同的两个提示在其它地方都有相同的输入,因此替换每个层次的标签符号的密钥和值使得其他位置完全计算出它在互换的提示中计算的内容. 任何变压器都是如此,通过层上诱导(附录D)。

blocks.en: The informative patches are the restricted ones. In SmolLM3, the keys and values at the label tokens in the reader layers 21–29 alone carry − 2.94 -2.94 of the − 5.55 -5.55 . In Qwen, the values of the 72 key–value groups of layers 21–29, at the label tokens, carry 86% of the exchange. The values of the eight sharpest readers carry − 2.16 -2.16 , while their keys carry + 0.56 +0.56 , which goes the wrong way. The label’s identity therefore sits on the value side of the slot, and it is read in the upper layers. Within the value side it is concentrated. Patching the values of single key–value groups shows that three of the 72 groups in layers 21–29 carry about half of the exchange’s effect, and that one group in layer 24 carries a quarter (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 信息补丁是限制的补丁. 在SmolLM3中,阅读层21–29的标签符上的键和值单载−5.55–5.55的2.94–2.94. 在 Quen 中, 标签符号上的72 键 - 值层 21 - 29 的值组, 承载了 86% 的交换值 。 八个最尖锐的阅读器的值携带−2.16 -2.16,而它们的键携带+0.56+0.56,这走错了方向. 因此,标签的特性坐落在槽的值侧,在上层被读取. 在价值方面,它集中。 补丁单键值组的数值显示,21至29层的72组中有3组承载了交换效应的一半,24层的一组承载了四分之一(图7 ).

blocks.en: The second experiment leaves the labels alone and changes a sentence instead. We replace one demonstration’s sentence with a sentence of the other class, so that foo now follows a complaint where it used to follow a compliment. This also moves the answer, by − 2.87 -2.87 nats on the six-demonstration battery, but now the effect runs through the keys. Patching the changed prompt’s keys at the label tokens in layers 21–29 carries − 2.35 -2.35 of it, and the eight sharpest readers’ keys carry − 0.55 -0.55 while their values carry + 0.10 +0.10 . In Llama the same experiment places the key in the label tokens’ keys and values in the middle layers only. Layers 7–13 and 14–20 each carry − 0.15 -0.15 of a − 0.23 -0.23 twin effect, while layers 0–6 and 21–27 carry − 0.02 -0.02 and − 0.04 -0.04 (Figure 8 a). The early layers have not yet written the key, and by the late layers it has already been read.
blocks.zh: 第二个实验留下标签,改换一句。 我们用另一类的句子代替一个示威的句子, 这也移动了答案,通过−2.87-2.87nats在六演示电池上,但现在效果贯穿了键. 将更改后的提示键在标签符上补上第21至29层的提示键,上面夹着−2.35至2.35,最尖锐的8个读者键上夹着−0.55至0.55,而其值则夹着+0.10+0.10。 在Llama,同样的实验将标记符号的键和值只放在中间层。 7–13层和14–20层各承−0.15–0.23–0.23双效,而0–6层和21–27层承−0.02–0.04–0.04(图8a). 早期的地层尚未写出密钥,到后期的地层已经读了.

blocks.en: A control confirms that this second experiment measures the class and not the particular sentence. Replacing a demonstration’s sentence with a different sentence of the same class and the same token length moves the answer by + 0.08 +0.08 nats, and every handoff from that twin stays within ± 0.06 \pm 0.06 . Whatever else the slot stores about its sentence, only the class reaches the answer. Figure 6 summarizes the three experiments.
blocks.zh: 一个控制证实,第二次实验测量的是类而不是特定的句子. 以不同句子的相同等级和相同符号长度取代演示句将答案移动+0.08+0.08纳特,每一次交接都停留在±0.06\pm0.06之内. 不管其他的插槽存储 关于它的句子, 只有阶级到达答案。 图6总结了这三项实验。

blocks.en: The label token cannot see its sentence directly, so attention has to carry the class to it. About twenty heads in layers 10–23 do this. Each attends from the label token back to the words of its own sentence and writes the class direction into the label’s residual stream. No one of them carries more than 5% of the effect, the top twenty together carry 64–92%, and knocking out six named writers does no more than knocking out six random heads from the same layers. What the writers write is a single direction u u per task, the same for both labels (held-out sign agreement 0.95–1.00), so a two-class key needs only one dimension.
blocks.zh: 标签符号不能直接看到它的句子,所以必须注意把类带给它. 大约20个头在10 -23层做这个。 每个都从标签符号返回到自己句子的文字,并将分类方向写入标签的剩余流中. 其中没有人能承受超过5%的效应,前二十位加起来能承受64–92 %,击倒六位有名的作家只能从同一层抽出六位随机头. 编剧们写的东西是每个任务一个单一的方向u u,两个标签(持有-退出标志协议0.95–1.00)都一样,所以一个双级的密钥只需要一个维度.

blocks.en: The write also has to be spread across depth: adding a given total dose of u u to the label tokens at one layer helps less than spreading the same dose over four layers. In SmolLM3, on the 144 prompts from the axes the model does not bind on its own (with the query’s class steered as well), a write at layer 16 alone gains + 0.37 +0.37 [+0.29, +0.46], and the same dose split over layers 12, 14, 16 and 18 gains + 0.56 +0.56 [+0.48, +0.65]. At double dose the single-layer write falls back to + 0.20 +0.20 [+0.09, +0.31], while the spread write keeps climbing, to + 0.69 +0.69 [+0.58, +0.81] (Figure 8 b). We take this as a sign that the writers are contextualisation heads. Each layer’s write is read and reshaped by the next, and a dose dropped into a single layer does not get the same treatment.
blocks.zh: 书写也须跨深度:将一定总剂量的u u 添加到一层的标签符上,比在四层上将同一剂量分布得更少. 在SmolLM3中,在轴线的144个导线上,模型本身没有绑定(也带有查询的类别),单在第16层的写法就会得到+0.37+0.37 [+0.29,+0.46],同样的剂量会分裂为第12,14,16和18层+0.56+0.56 [+0.48,+0.65]. 在双剂量时,单层写法会回落到+0.20+0.20 [+0.09,+0.31],而扩展写法则会不断攀升,到+0.69+0.69 [+0.58,+0.81] (图8 b). 我们将此视为作家是背景化的头目的标志。 每一层的书写被下层读取并重塑,一剂滴入一层就得不到同样的治疗.

blocks.en: Some features never bind, however many demonstrations the model sees. Word parity, the third letter of a word and rules about digits are examples, and none of them is represented linearly at the arrow. If we write u u into the slots of such a prompt by hand, accuracy rises from 50 to 71%, while key-only, query-only and random directions stay within ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 (Appendix C ). So when the key is present the rest of the circuit can use it, and when it is missing, nothing downstream makes up for it. We turn next to how the slots are read.
blocks.zh: 有些特征从来就没有约束过,尽管模型看到了许多示范。 单词对等,一个单词的第三个字母和关于数字的规则都是例子,没有一个在箭头上线性地表示. 如果我们用手将u u 写入这样一个提示的插槽中,精度从50%上升到71%,而只键,只查询和随机方向则停留在±0.1\pm 0.1(附录C)以内. 所以当键存在时,其余的电路都可以使用,当它缺失时,任何下游都无法弥补. 我们转过头来看插槽的读法。

blocks.en: Figure 6: The slot holds a value and a key on different sides of attention. (a) Exchanging the labels: in all three models the effect runs through the values at the label tokens. (b) Changing a sentence while keeping its label: the effect runs through the keys at the label tokens, and only in the middle layers. (c) Handoffs from a same-class sentence of the same length move the answer by at most 0.06 nats. Bars are paired effects on the margin with 95% bootstrap intervals; grey bars are size-matched random controls.
blocks.zh: 图6:槽在不同关注面上具有值和键. (a) 交换标签:在所有三个模型中,效果贯穿标签符号的值。 (b) 修改句子同时保留其标签:效果贯穿标签符号的密钥,并且只在中层. (c) 从相同长度的同级句子中取出最多0.06纳特的答案。 栏是边角上的配对效果,间隔为95%;灰色栏是大小匹配的随机控件.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Three key–value groups carry half of the label’s value. Patching the values of all 72 KV groups of layers 21–29 at the label tokens, from a prompt with the labels exchanged, carries 86% of the exchange’s effect on the margin (left). By layer, the effect sits in layers 22, 24 and 29 (right, grey), and within each of these layers one KV group carries most of it (red). Group 24.5 alone carries a quarter, and groups 24.5, 29.2 and 22.5 together carry about half. Random head sets of the same size move the margin by 0.03 or less (dotted). Qwen3-4B, 12-shot invented-label prompts, 72 prompts.
blocks.zh: 图7:3个关键价值组承载标签价值的一半。 将所有72个KV组的21–29层的值补到标签符上,从一个带有交换标签的提示起,就包含了交易所对边值(左)的86%的效果。 按层,效果坐落于第22,24和29层(右,灰色),在这些层中的每一层中,有一个KV组携带大部分(红色). 仅24.5组就携带四分之一,24.5组、29.2组和22.5组一起携带大约一半。 大小相同的随机头集移动比值为0.03或更小(dotted). Qune3-4B,12发发明的标签提示,72个提示.

blocks.en: Figure 8: The key is written in the middle layers, and the write has to be spread out. (a) In Llama-3.2-3B, patching the label-token keys and values from the sentence-exchanged prompt one layer band at a time: the two middle bands carry the effect, and the first and last carry almost none. (b) In SmolLM3, adding a fixed total dose of the class direction u u to the label tokens at one layer helps less than spreading it over four layers, and falls back at double dose while the spread write keeps climbing (95% intervals; 144 prompts).
blocks.zh: 图 8:键用中层书写,书写必须分散. (a) 在Llama-3.2-3B中,从句子交换中补齐标记键和值,一次提示一层带:两个中间带承载效果,第一个和最后一个带几乎无。 (b) 在SmolLM3中,在标签符号上加一个固定总剂量的分类方向u u,在一个层次上帮助小于将其分布在四个层次上,在扩散的文字不断攀升(95%的间隔;144个提示)时回落为双剂量。

blocks.en: 4 Reading the memory: reader heads and a softmax law
blocks.zh: 页:1 阅读记忆:读者头部和软马克思法

blocks.en: The lookup is done by attention heads in the upper layers, which we call readers. Each reader performs an ordinary softmax over the positions of the prompt, and the attention sink at position zero takes part in that softmax like any other position. Because the read is a softmax, the attention a reader pays to the matching slots should follow a simple expression with three constants per head, two of them separately identifiable. We can fit that expression in one regime and test it in another.
blocks.zh: 仰望是由上层的注意力头来完成,我们称之为读者. 每个读取器在提示器的位置上执行一个普通的软max,在零位置的注意力沉积像任何其他位置一样参与软max. 因为读数是软的,所以读者对匹配槽的注意应该遵循一个简单的表达式,每个头有3个常数,其中两个可以单独识别. 我们可以在一个制度下使用这一表述,在另一个制度下加以检验。

blocks.en: As algebra the proposition is trivial. Its content is the empirical claim that three numbers per head (two of them identifiable, since n rest n_{\mathrm{rest}} and e L sink e^{L_{\mathrm{sink}}} enter only through their sum), fitted once, describe how the head behaves as the prompt changes. We tested this by varying n m n_{m} and N N . On twelve-demonstration prompts with two, three, four or six classes (so that n m n_{m} is six, four, three or two), Equation 1 with three fitted constants reproduces the measured matching mass to within 0.1 for 127 of the 140 Qwen heads that put at least 0.03 of their attention on slots. In Llama it does so for 124 of 125 such heads, with a median maximum error of 0.02. Keeping each head’s three constants and setting n m = 1 n_{m}=1 , the law predicts the battery with one slot per class with a median error of 0.07 in Qwen (69% of heads within 0.1) and 0.04 in Llama (83%). blocks.en: Predicting in the other direction is where the law breaks down. We computed every head’s predicted mass on eighteen-demonstration prompts, which have three to nine slots per class, from the twelve-demonstration constants, and set ourselves the criterion of a median error below 0.07. The observed medians were 0.15 in Qwen and 0.13 in Llama, and 92–94% of heads were over-predicted. The attention patterns show why. A head’s null mass, its attention to the sink, is a constant of the head. The sharpest Qwen readers put 0.34–0.36 of their attention on the sink at every slot count and at both prompt lengths, and Llama’s put 0.42–0.45. A head’s total attention to the matching slots is nearly constant too. L29h11, for example, puts 0.18 on the matching slots when there are six of them and 0.19 when there are nine, so the extra matching slots divide a fixed class budget among themselves. Within one prompt length the growth from two to six slots per class is real, which is why the fit worked, but it saturates, and the fit absorbed the saturation into n rest n_{\mathrm{rest}} and L L .

The failure also established two facts that the rest of the paper relies on: the gate acts on a null mass that is fixed for each head, and because each head’s class budget is fixed, the readers have to act together to produce a large answer.

blocks.en: 5 A repeat signal gates the read
blocks.zh: 页:1 重复信号门 读取

blocks.en: A memory that is always read would be a liability. Most text contains no demonstrations, and a model that copied a label after every arrow would usually be wrong. The read should switch on only when there is something to read, and in these models the switch is a single direction in the residual stream at the query. It is computed from whether any label has appeared twice, and it works by lowering the logit that the readers assign to the attention sink. Figure 11 shows three readers in three states: reading when a label repeats, partly back on the sink when the repeat detectors are removed, and on the sink throughout when no label repeats.
blocks.zh: 总是被读取的记忆将是一种责任。 大多数文本没有包含演示内容,一个在每一个箭头之后复制标签的模型通常是错误的. 阅读器只应在有读物时开关,在这些模型中,在查询时开关是剩余流中的单一方向. 它从任何标签是否出现两次来计算,它通过降低读者分配给注意力槽的日志来工作. 图11显示三种状态中的三个读取器:一个标签重复时读取,重复探测器被移除时部分返回水槽上读取,没有标签重复时则在整个水槽上读取.

blocks.en: What first pointed us to a gate was the way accuracy depends on repetition. With one demonstration per class the model retrieves the right label about 20% of the time, with two per class 60–80% of the time, and with six, 96%. The requirement applies to the prompt as a whole. A label that appears only once is retrieved correctly as long as the other labels in the prompt repeat, so something in the statistics of the whole prompt opens the read.
blocks.zh: 首先指向大门的是准确性取决于重复。 通过每个班级一次演示,模型检索了大约20%的时间的正确标签,每个班60-80%的时间有两个,以及6,96%的时间。 这一要求适用于整个迅速情况。 只要在即时重复中的其他标签,只出现一次的标签就会被正确检索,所以整个即时的统计中有些东西会打开读数.

blocks.en: We call this direction g g and fit it on the residual stream at the query arrow in layer 23. There it separates prompts whose labels repeat from their token-identical twins whose labels are all distinct, with held-out sign agreement of 1.00, and it is orthogonal to the key direction u u . Prompts with repeated labels project onto it at about + 18 +18 , and their unique-label twins at about − 21 -21 .
blocks.zh: 我们称这个方向g,并将其装在23层的查询箭头的剩余流上. 它将重复其标签的双胞胎与标志性相同的双胞胎区分开来,其标签是完全不同的,持有1.00的标记协议,它正统地指向关键方向u u 。 带有重复标签的提示在 + 18 + 18 左右,其独特的标签双胞胎在 − 21 - 21 左右。

blocks.en: The signal reaches the arrow through flat pooling heads in layers 20–23, which attend evenly over the slots. Patching their values from the twin carries 93–100% of the projection, and patching their keys carries 3–10%. The slots carry the signal in the first place because of sixteen duplicate-token heads in layers 1–9, which attend from each label token to earlier copies of the same token. Mean-ablating these sixteen heads drives the projection on recurring-label prompts from + 18.3 +18.3 to − 0.3 -0.3 , about half of the way to the unique-label value of − 21 -21 . Sixteen random heads move it by at most 0.7, and the sixteen heads with the highest induction scores move it by 4.2 (Figure 10 a). The other half of the separation comes from elsewhere, and we do not know where. The duplicate-token detector is the first half of the classic induction circuit, and here it has a second job, which is to report that there is something to copy.
blocks.zh: 信号通过20–23层的扁平集合头到达箭头,在槽上均匀地进行. 从双胞胎中补丁他们的值 携带93-100%的投影,补丁他们的键携带3-10%. 由于第1至9层有16个重复敲头头,所以插槽首先携带信号,这些重复敲头头从每个标签符号到同一符号的较早副本。 这16个头的平滑作用促使反复出现的标签提示的投影从+18.3+18.3到−0.3-0.3,大约一半的时间到−21-21. 16个随机头最多以0.7移动它,16个诱导得分最高的头最多以4.2移动它(图10 a). 另一半分离来自其他地方,我们不知道在哪里。 重复式触控探测器是经典感应电路的前半部分,这里有第二个工作,那就是报告有东西可以复制.

blocks.en: The readers’ softmax includes the sink at position zero, and a reader that puts most of its attention there copies nothing. Adding g g to the residual stream at the arrow of a unique-label prompt, at the dose the model itself uses, lowers each reader’s sink logit relative to its matching-slot logit, by 1.75 nats at L24h8, 3.25 at L28h0 and 3.65 at L29h11. Across the distributed readers the drop is 0.74 at the natural dose and 1.41 at double dose, and a random direction of the same norm moves it by at most 0.2 (Figure 10 b). The gap between the matching and non-matching slot logits also widens, by + 0.34 +0.34 to + 0.48 +0.48 nats (a factor of about 1.5 in the attention ratio), roughly a seventh of the effect on the sink (Figure 10 c). Patching in the whole recurring-label twin moves the sink logit by the same 1.5–3.9 nats and leaves that gap unchanged or smaller. The gate acts mainly on the null logit, and its smaller effect on matching is not zero.
blocks.zh: 读者的软马克包括零位置的沉淀物, 在唯一标签提示的箭头,当模型本身使用的剂量时,将gg加到残余流中,将每个读取器的槽对数相对于其匹配的槽对数降低1.75纳特,在L24h8、L28h0和L29h11的3.65。 在整个分布式读物中,自然剂量的下降为0.74,双剂量为1.41,同一规范的随机方向最多移动0.2(图10b)。 配位与非配位对数之间的差距也扩大,比值为+0.34+0.34+0.48+0.48 nats(在注意比中约为1.5的系数),大约为对汇的影响的七分之一(图10 c). 在整个反复出现的标签双胞胎中补丁将汇的对数按相同的1.5-3.9纳特移动,使这一缺口保持不变或较小。 闸门主要作用于无效的登录,其对匹配的较小效果不是零.

blocks.en: The weights tell the same story. g g projects onto the sink-versus-slots query functionals of the 89 upper-layer slot-reading heads with the sign that releases the read. The population cosine is − 0.03 -0.03 , against a random | cos | |\cos| of 0.015, and the clearest individual heads reach − 0.09 -0.09 to − 0.11 -0.11 . It does not project onto the same heads’ match functionals ( | cos | ≤ 0.02 |\cos|\leq 0.02 ). It carries 10–11% of its energy in the span of these heads’ functionals, against 3.3% for a random subspace of the same dimension. The sign and the selectivity are therefore properties of the weights, while the magnitude is spread over more heads than our census of slot-reading heads contains.

blocks.en: Corollary 1 explains why the gate acts where it does. A softmax must put its mass somewhere, and for these heads position zero is the sink, the place where they put the attention they do not spend on the slots. (Its value is not inert, as Section 8.3 shows, but the heads use it as a place to put unspent attention.) A reader whose null logit exceeds its match logits returns the sink’s value, and the model emits nothing in particular. This is the null action. It is a consequence of the architecture, and the only lever a prompt-level signal has on it is the reader’s query, which is where g g acts, with the sign the corollary requires.
blocks.zh: 编年史第1卷解释了为什么城门的行为地点. 一个软马克斯必须将其质量放在某个地方,对于这些头部位置0是水槽,也就是他们把注意力不花在槽上的地方. (其价值并非惰性,如第8.3节所示,但头部将其作为未用注意的地方. ) 阅读器的无效记录超过匹配记录返回汇值,而模型则不特别显示。 这是无效的行动。 这是这个架构的结果,它上唯一一个即时级信号的杠杆是读者的查询,这是g行为的地方,并带有必然结果要求的标志.

blocks.en: 6 Two heads write the query code
blocks.zh: 6个 两个头写查询代码

blocks.en: The slot keys are one side of the match, and the other side is whatever the readers bring from the query. One might expect the query to carry the same class direction u u that the slots hold, so that the match is a dot product of like with like. It turns out that the query carries a code of its own, written by two heads and shaped for the readers that consume it.
blocks.zh: 槽键是匹配的一面,另一面是读者从查询中带来的任意. 人们可能会期望查询会携带与插槽所持有的类方向u u ,这样,匹配就是一种像这样的点产品. 事实证明,查询带有自己的代码,由两个头写成,为消耗它的读者塑造.

blocks.en: The experiment is the query flip. We replace the query sentence with one of the other class and patch single activations from the flipped prompt into the intact run at the arrow. Patching the attention outputs of layers 21–29 carries − 1.10 -1.10 [-1.39, -0.82] of the − 1.33 -1.33 -nat flip in Qwen, so the readers’ layers are where the query’s class acts. Patching the outputs of just two heads one layer earlier, L22h10 and L23h26, carries − 0.53 -0.53 [-0.68, -0.39], or 40% of the flip, while any pair of random heads from the same layers carries less than 0.05. These two heads compute the query’s class at the arrow.
blocks.zh: 实验是查询翻转. 我们把查询句子替换为另一类之一,并补上从翻转的提示到箭头完好运行的单次激活. 将21–29层的注意力输出补上-1.10–1.10 [1.39, -0.82] Qwen中的-1.33–1.33–nat翻转,因此读者的层次是查询的阶级行为所在. L22h10和L23h26在稍早时只补补两个头的输出,搭载−0.53 - 0.53 [-0.68, -0.39],即翻转的40%,而任何对来自同一层的随机头搭载不到0.05. 这两个头在箭头处计算查询的类。

blocks.en: What they write is not u u . It has cosine 0.07 with the key direction, and it does not line up with the weight-probe direction of any single reader. It is, however, the direction that moves the reader population’s match logits. For each reader, the query-side functional for “match against the class- c c key” is a vector in residual space, W Q ⊤ W_{Q}^{\top} applied to the mean key difference. The span of these functionals over the readers of layers 24–29 contains 64% of the pair’s write, against 4% for a random subspace of the same dimension. In other words, the code is written in the readers’ own coordinates.
blocks.zh: 他们写的不是uu。 它有0.07的余弦与关键方向,它不与任何单个读取器的重量探测方向排队. 读者人数的对数, 对于每个阅读器来说,“与类-c c 键对齐”的查询-侧功能是剩余空间中的矢量,W Q Q QQ Top}适用于平均键差。 这些功能在24–29层的阅读器上的跨度包含64%的对子写法,而同一维度的随机子空间则包含4%。 换句话说,代码是用读者自己的坐标书写的。

blocks.en: To find which components consume the code, we held downstream components at their intact values while the pair’s handoff ran. Holding the attention queries of layers 24–29 removes most of the effect ( − 0.14 -0.14 remains), holding layers 24–35 removes 93% of it ( − 0.04 -0.04 remains), and holding the late MLPs as well leaves − 0.01 -0.01 . Holding the late MLPs alone makes the effect larger ( − 0.66 -0.66 ), which means that in the intact run they push against the query code. Putting this together, two heads write the code at layers 22–23, the attention queries of layers 24–35 read it (the copiers of layers 30–35 take the last quarter), and the final MLPs oppose it.
blocks.zh: 为了找到哪些组件消耗了代码,我们把下游组件按完好无损的数值保存在了对子的交接中。 持有第24层至第29层的注意力询问可以消除大部分效果(残留为−0.14-0.14),持有第24层至第35层可以消除其中的93%(残留为−0.04-0.04),持有晚期的MLP以及叶子−0.01-0.01。 仅持有后期的MLP就使得效果更大(− 0.66-0.66),这意味着在完好无损的运行中,它们会推向查询码. 将这个组合起来,两个头在22–23层写代码,24–35层的注意力查询读(30–35层的复印机取最后一季度),最后的MLP反对.

blocks.en: How concentrated the query computation is varies by model. SmolLM3 spreads it over more heads, with no pair carrying 40%, and Llama’s query-side effect spans layers 10–27 (band handoffs of − 0.03 -0.03 , − 0.18 -0.18 and − 0.13 -0.13 for layers 0–9, 10–17 and 18–27). In all three models, though, the query carries a code that is separate from the key and is consumed by the readers’ queries. Figure 12 shows the consumer map and the functional-span test.
blocks.zh: 如何集中查询计算因模型而异. SmolLM3将它分布在更多的头部,没有带40 %的对子,Llama的查询-侧效应跨层10–27(带位传递−0.03–0.03, −0.18–0.18和-0.13–0.13,层0–9,10–17和18–27). 不过,在所有三种模式中,查询都带有与密钥分开的代码,被读者的查询所消耗. 图12显示了消费地图和功能宽度测试。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Two heads write a query code that the reader population consumes. (a) Share of the query-flip effect carried by the pair L22h10+L23h26 and by all attention in layers 21–29, and what remains when downstream attention queries are held at their intact values. (b) Energy of the pair’s write in the span of the readers’ match functionals, against random subspaces of the same dimension.
blocks.zh: 图12:两个头写一个读者人口所消费的查询代码. (a) L22h10+L23h26对子和21-29对子的注意所带的查询-闪光效应份额,以及下游注意查询按完好无损的数值进行时的剩余部分。 (b) 在阅读器匹配功能的间隙中,对同一维度的随机子空间对对对对对对对对对对对的写法的能量。

blocks.en: 7 Readers and brakes act as populations
blocks.zh: 7 读者和制动器作为人口

blocks.en: Figure 13: No single head carries the answer. Each cell is the effect on the 12-shot class margin of knocking out one head at the query position (mean over 144 prompts from six label families; blue lowers the margin and red raises it; colour clipped at ± 0.15 \pm 0.15 nats), for every head in the reader layers of Qwen3-4B-Base (layers 21–35) and Llama-3.2-3B (layers 16–27). Outlined cells are the five most negative and five most positive heads. The largest single-head effects are − 0.14 -0.14 nats (Qwen L23h26, a query head) and + 0.13 +0.13 (Qwen L31h30, a brake), and − 0.09 -0.09 and + 0.12 +0.12 in Llama (L18h10, L19h1), against a 1.3-nat margin. The sets built from these rankings move the margin by − 0.74 -0.74 and + 1.39 +1.39 in Qwen and by − 0.56 -0.56 and + 1.90 +1.90 in Llama when knocked out together (Table B ).
blocks.zh: 图13:没有单头携带答案。 每个单元格是对在查询位置敲出一个头部的12发类边距的影响(平均超过144个来自6个标签家庭的提示;蓝色降低边距并增加红色;彩色剪辑为±0.15\pm 0.15 nats),对于Qune3-4B-Base(层21–35)和Llama-3.2-3B(层16–27)的阅读层中的每个头部. 提纲细胞是五个最阴性,五个最阳性. 最大的单头效应是−0.14-0.14纳特(Quen L23h26,一个查询头)和+0.13+0.13(Quen L31h30,一个制动器),而Llama的−0.09-0.09和+0.12+0.12(L18h10,L19h1)比分为1.3纳特边. 从这些排名中构建的套装在Quen中移动比值为− 0.74-0.74和+1.39+1.39,在Llama被击倒时移动比值为− 0.56-0.56和+1.90+1.90(表B)。

blocks.en: There are about ninety readers, and about two dozen heads work against them. Both numbers are large next to the handful of heads that circuit analyses usually name, and in this section we explain why the model uses so many.
blocks.zh: 读者约九十人,头目约二十余人与之作对. 这两个数字都很大 旁边的几个头 电路分析通常命名, 在这个节中,我们解释为什么模型使用这么多。

blocks.en: A reader, concretely, is an upper-layer head whose attention from the arrow prefers the slots whose class matches the query. Twenty readers chosen on one draw of prompts and knocked out together on a fresh draw cost − 0.74 -0.74 [-0.95, -0.55] nats, while twenty random heads from the same layers cost + 0.02 +0.02 . No single reader is necessary. The largest single-head knockout among the readers in Qwen costs 0.09 nats, and the two query heads, 23:26 and 22:10, cost 0.14 and 0.12 (Figure 13 ). Against the readers stand the brakes, twenty-four heads in layers 22–34 that write against the label the model has just seen. Knocking them out on a fresh draw raises the margin by + 1.39 +1.39 [+0.88, +1.88], nearly tripling it, while twenty-four random heads give + 0.22 +0.22 . The brakes are negative heads, like the negative name movers of the indirect-object circuit and the heads that perform copy suppression. They take a label that is being copied and push the logits the other way.
blocks.zh: 一个阅读器,具体地说,是一个上层头部,其来自箭头的注意力更偏爱其类与查询相符的插槽. 20个读者选在一幅图纸上,在一张新图纸上一起敲掉 — 0.74-0.74 [-0.95, -0.55] nats, 而同一层的20个随机头则花费+0.02+0.02. 不需要单一的读者。 昆文读者中最大的单头击球花费0.09纳特,两个查询头23:26和22:10,花费0.14和0.12(图13). 24个头在22-34层, 写在模型刚刚看到的标签上。 以新抽取的方式击倒它们,将比值提高+1.39+1.39[+0.88,+1.88],几乎翻倍,而二十四个随机头给出+0.22+0.22. 制动器是负头,如间接-物体电路的负名移动器和进行复制压制的头. 他们把一个被复制的标签 推向另一边

blocks.en: The brakes calibrate the model against the order of the demonstrations. Permuting the demonstrations leaves the mean margin unchanged, but on half of the prompts it moves the margin by more than a nat. The readers themselves are biased toward recent slots, with a gradient of 0.5–0.85 nats from the first slot to the last, and with the brakes removed the model follows that gradient and prefers whichever label came last. At six demonstrations the brakes supply the anti-recency term outright, and at twelve they keep the model order-neutral against the readers’ pull. Figure 14 shows the interaction between readers and brakes and the order effect, and Appendix E gives the details.
blocks.zh: 制动器将模型校准于示威的顺序. 示威示威活动使平均比值保持不变,但在一半的提示上,平均比值移动了1纳特以上。 阅读器本身偏向于最近的插槽,从第一个插槽到最后一个插槽的梯度为0.5-0.85纳特,随着制动器的拆除,模型遵循了梯度,更喜欢哪个标签是最后一个。 在六场示威中,制动装置直接提供抗耐受一词,在十二场演示中,它们保持模式订单对读者的拉力保持中立。 图14显示了阅读器与制动器之间的相互作用和顺序效应,附录E给出了细节.

blocks.en: One might think the model spreads the read over ninety heads because no single head can tell the classes apart. The attention patterns rule this out. A single reader’s class bias is 0.2–0.4 nats against a per-slot spread of about 0.5, so one head already separates the classes in its own attention pattern, if weakly. What no head has is enough output gain.
blocks.zh: 人们可能会认为模型将读数传播到90个头部,因为没有一个头部能把班级区分开来。 关注模式排除了这一点。 单一读者的班级偏差为0.2–0.4纳特,而每集的班级分布约为0.5,因此,一个头已经按照自己的注意力模式把班级分开,如果是弱的的话。 没有头部的就是足够的输出收益.

blocks.en: Let head i i attend with mass m i m_{i} to slots whose values differ by Δ ​ v \Delta v between the two labels, with output-value matrix W O ​ V ( i ) W_{OV}^{(i)} , and let w w be the final-norm-scaled unembedding direction of the correct minus the alternative label. The head’s direct contribution to the margin is at most m i ​ ‖ W O ​ V ( i ) ​ Δ ​ v ‖ ​ ‖ w ‖ / ρ m_{i}\,\|W_{OV}^{(i)}\Delta v\|\,\|w\|/\rho , where ρ \rho is the RMS scale of the final residual. If the margin M M is carried by the heads’ direct contributions and every head’s bound is at most β \beta , at least ⌈ M / β ⌉ \lceil M/\beta\rceil heads contribute.

When we measured it, no head in Qwen wrote more than 0.2 nats of the answer logit directly (Section 8 ). A 1.3-nat margin is therefore a sum over at least seven heads, and a 1.3-nat class flip, in which a head’s contribution may change sign, a sum over at least four. In practice the model uses 14 heads for half of the flip and 46 for 80%. It is gain that forces the populations, and a lack of signal in single heads plays no part. We therefore describe the populations by the direction they read and write and test that direction against random subspaces. A search for a single responsible head would be looking for something that the bound says cannot exist.
blocks.zh: 当我们测量时,Quen中没有任何一个头直接写下超过0.2纳特的回答记录(第8节)。 因此,1.3纳特比值是至少7个头以上的总和,是1.3纳特级的翻转,其中头部的贡献可能改变标志,是至少4个以上的总和。 在实际操作中,该模型使用14个头对半翻转,46个头对80%. 迫使民众行动是有好处的,单头人缺乏信号是没有作用的。 因此,我们用它们读写的方向来描述种群,对照随机的子空间来测试该方向. 寻找一个负责的脑袋,就是寻找被束缚者说不存在的东西。

blocks.en: The same arithmetic gave us a prediction to test. Knocking out the seven largest direct movers in the copier band should remove 0.3–0.5 of the + 0.68 +0.68 twelve-demonstration margin. It removed − 0.16 -0.16 [-0.56, +0.24], which has the predicted sign but is smaller than predicted, with an interval that includes zero. We count this as weak support.
blocks.zh: 同样的算术给了我们一个测试的预测. 击倒复印机带内7个最大直接移动器应去除+0.68+0.68十二演示比值的0.3-0.5. 它移除了−0.16-0.16 [-0.56,+0.24],它有预言的标志,但比预言的要小,间隔包括0. 我们将此视为支持不力。

blocks.en: Figure 14: Readers and brakes act as populations with opposite signs. (a) Joint knockout of 20 readers, of 24 brakes, and of both, on a fresh draw, against size-matched random sets (grey). (b) Order effect: the margin against the position of the last matching demonstration, intact and with the brakes knocked out.
blocks.zh: 图14:阅读器和制动器具有相反标志的人群。 (a) 联合淘汰20个读取器,24个制动器,以及两个制动器在新抽取时与大小匹配的随机装置(灰色)相对应。 (b) 秩序效应:与最后一次匹配演示位置的比值,完整无损,与刹车一起被击倒。

blocks.en: 8 Accounting for the answer
blocks.zh: 第8条 答案的清点

blocks.en: So far we have located each step by the change it causes. For a single prompt we can also ask a stricter question: which components wrote the answer’s logit, and how much did each one write? The residual stream before the final norm is a sum over components, so the answer logit decomposes exactly.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们通过它造成的变化,确定了每个步骤。 对于一个提示,我们也可以问一个更严格的问题:哪个组件会写出答案的日志,每个组件写了多少? 最终规范之前的剩余流是一个总和超过组件,因此答案对数分解准确.

blocks.en: 8.1 Direct contributions
blocks.zh: 8.1 直接捐款

blocks.en: Let x = e + ∑ i a i + ∑ l m l x=e+\sum_{i}a_{i}+\sum_{l}m_{l} be the final residual at the arrow, with e e the embedding, a i a_{i} the head outputs and m l m_{l} the MLP outputs, and let ρ = rms ⁡ ( x ) \rho=\mathrm{rms}(x) . With w = γ ⊙ W U ⊤ ​ ( 𝟏 y − 𝟏 y ′ ) w=\gamma\odot W_{U}^{\top}(\mathbf{1}_{y}-\mathbf{1}_{y^{\prime}}) for the final-norm gain γ \gamma and labels y , y ′ y,y^{\prime} , the margin is logit ⁡ ( y ) − logit ⁡ ( y ′ ) = ( w ⊤ ​ e + ∑ i w ⊤ ​ a i + ∑ l w ⊤ ​ m l ) / ρ \mathrm{logit}(y)-\mathrm{logit}(y^{\prime})=\big(w^{\top}e+\sum_{i}w^{\top}a_{i}+\sum_{l}w^{\top}m_{l}\big)/\rho .

Proposition 3 is an identity, and we use it as a check. On every prompt, the right-hand side computed from the hooked components agrees with the model’s own margin, with a mean error of 0.045 nats in Qwen and 0.048 in SmolLM3. With that check in place, the decomposition tells us who writes the answer. On intact twelve-demonstration prompts the margin is + 0.68 +0.68 nats. Attention in layers 30–35 contributes + 0.66 +0.66 , attention in layers 21–29 contributes + 0.14 +0.14 , and the late MLPs contribute − 0.11 -0.11 . Under the exact class flip the answer swings by − 1.33 -1.33 : the layer 30–35 band moves by − 1.12 -1.12 , the readers by − 0.36 -0.36 , and the late MLPs by + 0.25 +0.25 , in the opposite direction.
blocks.zh: 提议3是一个身份, 我们用它作为检查。 在每个时速上,从上钩组件中计算出来的右侧与模型自身的边距一致,在Qwen和SmolLM3中平均误差为0.045纳特. 检查完成后 分解结果告诉我们是谁写的答案 在完好无损的十二度演示上,比值为+0.68+0.68纳特。 注意层30–35贡献+0.66+0.66,注意层21–29贡献+0.14+0.14,后期的MLP贡献−0.11-0.11. 在准确的班次下,将答案的摇摆按−1.33–1.33:层30–35的带动按−1.12–1.12,阅读器按−0.36–0.36,后期的MLP按+0.25+0.25,方向相反.

blocks.en: The readers, then, are the source of the answer, but they write little of it themselves. They collect the label values into the arrow, a band of copier heads in the last six layers reads what they collected and writes the logits, and the final MLPs act as a prior toward the label seen most often and oppose the flip. In Qwen, fourteen heads carry half of the direct swing and 46 carry 80%; in SmolLM3 the numbers are eight and 45. Figure 16 shows the decomposition as a waterfall, and Figure 15 shows how the swing is concentrated over heads. The direct accounting credits each nat to the last component that wrote it, while the handoffs of the earlier sections credit it to its source, and between them they close the path from slot to logit. Section 8.3 shows that the copiers are one of three routes out of the readers, and Appendix follows a single prompt through every layer and position.
blocks.zh: 因此,读者是答案的来源,但他们自己写得很少. 他们将标签值收集到箭头中,最后六层的一组复印机头阅读他们收集到的东西并写下日志,最后的MLP作为最经常看到的标签的前身,反对翻转. 在Quen中,14个头携带一半的直接摇摆,46个头携带80%;在SmolLM3中,数字为8和45. 图16显示分解为瀑布,图15显示秋千是如何集中在头部的. 直接的会计贷记每个纳特到写它的最后部分,而前几节的交割则贷记到它的源头,在它们之间,它们从槽到登录关闭路径. 第8.3节显示,复印机是阅读器的三条路线之一,附录通过每一层和每个位置遵循一个单一的提示.

blocks.en: Figure 15: Every nat of the answer assigned to a component. (a) Direct contributions to the margin by layer band, intact and under the class flip, in Qwen and SmolLM3. (b) Cumulative share of the flip against the number of heads, sorted by contribution.
blocks.zh: 图15:分配给某个组件的每个答题。 (a) 在Quen和SmolLM3中,按层次波段、完整地和在类翻下对差值的直接贡献。 (b) 与头数对比的累计份额,按捐款排序。

blocks.en: Figure 16: The answer as a sum of bands. Left: the intact twelve-demonstration margin in Qwen, built up band by band; the copier band of layers 30–35 writes almost all of it. Right: the change under the exact class flip. The copier band carries most of the swing and the readers a quarter, and the late MLPs push the other way.
blocks.zh: 图16:作为波段总和的答案. 左派:在Quen中完整无缺的12个演示边框,由乐队建立;30–35层的复印机乐队几乎全部写下. 右:在准确的类翻下的变化. 复印机乐队搭载了大部分的摇摆和阅读器四分之一,而后期的MLP则推向相反的方向.

blocks.en: 8.2 Faithfulness, completeness and minimality
blocks.zh: 8.2 忠诚、完整和最低限度

blocks.en: Wang et al. (2022) ask three things of a circuit: that it be faithful, complete and minimal. The exact decomposition above is an accounting identity and does not test faithfulness. The real test is to keep only the named heads and replace the output of every other head with a reference value. We do this at the query position. We keep the writers, the duplicate-token, pooling, query, reader, brake and copier heads (67 in all) and the late MLPs, and replace the output of every other head at the query. Because the replacement happens only at the query, every other position, including the label tokens where the slots are built, runs as in the intact model. The test therefore asks whether the named heads are enough for the computation at the query, given intact slots. What it certifies is the readout from the slots; the evidence for how the slots are built is the handoffs and swaps of Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 王等人(2022年)问道三件事:忠贞,完整,最小. 以上确切的分解是会计身份,不检验忠诚度. 真正的测试是只保留命名的头部,并以参考值取代其他每个头部的输出. 我们在查询位置这样做。 我们保留编剧,复制人,集合,查询,阅读,制动和复印机头(总共67个)和后期的MLP,并替换查询时其他每个头的输出. 因为替换只发生在查询时,所以其他每个位置,包括建槽的标签符,都运行在完好无损的模型中. 因此,测试询问,在给出完好无损的插槽的情况下,命名的头是否足以在查询中进行计算. 它所证明的是从插槽中读出;插槽如何构建的证据是第3节的交割和互换.

blocks.en: The choice of reference matters a great deal. With means taken over natural text, the named set keeps nothing, and the margin goes to − 0.79 -0.79 / − 0.88 -0.88 nats from an intact + 1.13 +1.13 / + 0.55 +0.55 (rare / symbol labels). But a random set of the same size does no worse ( − 0.83 -0.83 / − 0.79 -0.79 ), and neither does keeping no heads at all ( − 0.82 -0.82 / − 0.81 -0.81 ). Replacing a thousand heads with a value 2.5 times further from their own output than the battery mean pushes the query residual away from anything the late layers have seen, and the test can no longer rank head sets. With the reference that Wang et al. (2022) use, the mean over a matched distribution, the test does rank them. “Matched” has to cover the label pair as well. The battery stores each prompt under two label pairs, and a reference that mixes them, or a resample partner that is the same prompt under the other pair, moves the results by up to a nat in either direction. Our first version of this control made exactly that mistake, and Appendix describes the error and how it biased the results. Every value below uses the mean over same-pair prompts at the query, or a resampled same-pair prompt.
blocks.zh: 参考文献的选择非常重要。 使用对自然文本的接收手段,命名的集合保持无保留,边距从完好无损的+1.13+1.13 /+ 0.55 (稀有/符号标签)到−0.79 -0.79 / - 0.88-0.88 nats. 但同样大小的随机组合并不差(−0.83-0.83 /− 0.79-0.79),也不保留任何头部(−0.82-0.82 /−0.81-0.81). 取代1000个头部,其值比电池本身的输出要远2.5倍,这意味着将查询剩余部分推离后层看到的任何东西,测试不能再对头部进行排序. 参照王等人(2022年)使用,平均值大于匹配分布,测试确实将其排序. “Matched”也必须覆盖标签对。 电池在两个标签对下存储每个提示,以及一个混合它们的引用,或者另一个对下同样提示的再模拟伴侣,将结果移动到两个方向上最多一个nat. 我们这个控制的第一个版本正是犯了这个错误,附录描述了这个错误及其如何偏向结果. 下方的每个值在查询时都会使用同一pair提示的平均值,或者重印的同一pair提示.

blocks.en: With the named set plus the eight heads that a screen of layers 20–27 adds and the four early heads from the screen of layers 0–19 (79 heads; Appendix ), the circuit alone keeps about 60% of the margin on both label kinds. Under resampling the circuit-only margin sits − 0.28 -0.28 [-0.50, -0.09] below the intact + 0.55 +0.55 on symbol labels and − 0.47 -0.47 below + 1.14 +1.14 on rare ones, against − 0.65 -0.65 / − 0.98 -0.98 (symbol / rare) for a random set of about the same size drawn from the same layers and − 0.69 -0.69 / − 0.95 -0.95 for keeping no heads. Removing the complement one band at a time shows where the rest is: layers 0–19 cost − 0.16 -0.16 / − 0.29 -0.29 , layers 20–27 cost − 0.07 -0.07 / − 0.10 -0.10 , and layers 28–35 give + 0.09 +0.09 / + 0.17 +0.17 . Removing the unnamed late heads helps, in other words, because on balance they act as brakes.
blocks.zh: 加上一个20–27层的屏幕所添加的8个头,以及从0–19层的屏幕(79个头;附录)所显示的4个早期头部,仅电路就保留了两种标签种类的60%左右的比值. 在复标仅电路比值下,符号标签上位于完好的+0.55+0.55以下,稀有标签上位于−0.47-0.47以下+1.14+1.14,相对于0.65-0.65/−0.98-0.98(同位素/稀有)从同层抽取的大小大致相同的随机组合,没有头部则位于−0.69-0.69/−0.95. 一次移除一个补充带,显示其余部分: 第0–19层 成本 - 0.16 - 0.16 / - 0.29 - 0.29, 第20–27层 成本 - 0.07 - 0.07 / - 0.10 - 0.10, 第28–35层 给出 + 0.09 + 0.09 / + 0.17 + 0.17 。 换句话说,移除那些未命名的后头有帮助,因为它们在平衡上起到制动作用。

blocks.en: The natural-label study of Section 10 later adds 110 heads, readers and brakes that matter when the label is a word. With that final set of 189 heads, the circuit alone does better than the intact model on both label kinds ( + 0.89 +0.89 / + 1.26 +1.26 under resampling and + 0.93 +0.93 / + 1.62 +1.62 with the mean reference, symbol / rare; a random set gives − 0.64 -0.64 / − 0.98 -0.98 ). Removing the remaining heads of the two late bands helps ( + 0.40 +0.40 / + 0.99 +0.99 and + 0.35 +0.35 / + 0.65 +0.65 ), and only the encoder band still costs anything ( − 0.07 -0.07 / − 0.17 -0.17 ). Within the layers where the mechanism lives, then, the circuit is complete, and the same protocol closes it in SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.2-3B as well (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 第10节的自然标签研究后来增加了110个头,读取器和刹车,当标签是一个单词时,它们就很重要. 有了最终的189个头,光电路就比两种标签型号上完整无缺的型号更好(复标下为+0.89+0.89 / + 1.26+1.26,复标下为+0.93+0.93 / +1.62 + 1.62;随机电路给−0.64-0.64 /−0.98-0.98),去除两个后期波段的其余头部有帮助(+0.40+0.40 / +0.99+0.99和+0.35+0.35+0.65+0.65),只有编码器的波段仍然花费任何费用(−0.07-0.07 /−0.17-0.17),在机制生活的各层中,电路是完整的,同一项协议在SmolLM3-3B和Llama-3.2-3B中关闭(附录))。

blocks.en: A second sense of completeness asks whether the named sets carry their function on prompts they were not chosen on. Every named set was selected on one draw of prompts and tested on a fresh draw against random sets of the same size and layers. The readers cost − 0.74 -0.74 against + 0.02 +0.02 , the brakes give + 1.39 +1.39 against + 0.22 +0.22 , and the Llama sets give + 1.90 +1.90 and − 0.56 -0.56 against + 0.12 +0.12 and 0.00 0.00 .
blocks.zh: 第二种完整的感觉是,所命名的套件是否在未选中的提示上具有功能。 每个命名的集都是在一幅画的提示上选择的,并且用一张新的画来测试大小和层数相同的随机集. 阅读器花费−0.74-0.74对+0.02+0.02,制动器给出+1.39+1.39对+0.22+0.22,Llama套装给出+1.90+1.90和−0.56-0.56对+0.12+0.12和0.000.

blocks.en: Minimality is where our account departs from a sparse circuit. No single reader or brake is necessary in the intact network. The largest single-head cost in Qwen is 0.14 nats (the query head 23:26; the largest reader costs 0.09) and in Llama 0.09, and the largest single brake raises the margin by 0.13 and 0.12. Wang et al. (2022) ’s criterion is weaker than this, since it lets a head count as necessary once the others are removed, and we have not run that conditional test. What Proposition 2 rules out is a single head carrying a 1.3-nat answer when no head writes more than 0.2 nats. In place of a minimal head set we report populations with direction-level tests, and we say so wherever this applies.
blocks.zh: 最小化就是我们的账户 离开一个稀疏的线路。 在完好无损的网络中不需要单读器或刹车. 奎恩最大的单头成本为0.14纳茨(查询头23:26;最大的读者成本为0.09)和Llama 0.09,最大的单头制动提高了比值0.13和0.12. Wang et al. (2022)的标准比这个要弱,因为一旦其他标准被移除,它就让一个头数成为必要的,我们还没有进行这个条件测试. 2号提案规定,当没有头写得超过0.2纳特时,一个单头携带1.3纳特的答案. 我们用最小的头部来报告人群 并进行方向测试,只要适用,我们都会这么说。

blocks.en: 8.3 Cutting the connections
blocks.zh: 8.3 联合国 切断连接

blocks.en: The interventions so far establish the parts, but the connections between them were inferred from the parts existing side by side. Four further experiments cut the connections directly, each on fresh prompt draws in Qwen3-4B (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 迄今为止的干预确定了这些部分,但从并存的部分推断出它们之间的联系。 另有4项实验直接切断连接,每件在新鲜的即时抽取Qune3-4B(表3).

blocks.en: We take the concept battery and its class-flipped twin, and patch the twenty readers’ outputs at the query from the twin into the intact run. This carries − 1.08 -1.08 nats of the twin’s − 1.80 -1.80 on rare-word labels and − 0.54 -0.54 of − 0.95 -0.95 on symbol labels, so sixty percent of everything that differs between the two prompts passes through those twenty heads. We then hold the inputs of every attention head in layers 30–35 at their intact values, while the readers’ outputs still come from the twin. The effect drops to − 0.81 -0.81 and − 0.35 -0.35 . Holding the inputs of the layer 30–35 MLPs as well brings it down to − 0.39 -0.39 and − 0.19 -0.19 . Of what the readers write, a quarter to a third is read by late attention heads (the copiers), about forty percent by the late MLPs, and the remaining third goes straight to the logits. The connection from readers to copiers is real, but it is one of three routes out of the readers.
blocks.zh: 将二十位读者的输出从双胞胎到完整运行。 这上面有1.08-1.08个双胞胎的鼻孔 — 1.80-1.80个稀有字标签,0.54-0.54个−0.95个符号标签,因此,两个音符之间所有差异的60%都经过这20个头。 然后,我们把每一个关注点的投入都放在第30至35层,以完整的价值来衡量,而读者的产出仍然来自双胞胎。 效果下降到−0.81-0.81和−0.35-0.35. 持有层30-35 MLP的输入量也使其降至−0.39-0.39和−0.19-0.19。 在读者所写的书中,四分之一到三分之一是由迟到的注意力头(复印机)读的,大约40%是由晚到的MLP读的,剩下的三分之一直接读到对数. 从读者到复印机的连接是真实的,但它是走出读者的三条路线之一.

blocks.en: We knock out the sixteen duplicate-token heads and add the gate direction g g back at layer 23 of the query. On unique-label prompts, where the gate is normally closed, this opens it. The margin rises by + 0.58 +0.58 nats at one unit of g g and by + 0.90 +0.90 at two, and the sharp reader L29h11 moves its attention off the sink (0.91 to 0.37). We then remove the direction g g from the twenty readers’ query inputs alone, leaving it everywhere else. The rise falls to + 0.43 +0.43 and + 0.61 +0.61 , and L29h11’s sink mass climbs back (0.37 to 0.51; 0.35 to 0.62). Removing a random direction of the same kind from the same queries changes nothing ( + 0.58 +0.58 , + 0.92 +0.92 , sink mass unchanged). A quarter to a third of what g g does to the answer therefore travels through the readers’ queries, the route that our account draws, and the rest reaches the answer through heads and MLPs we have not named. On recurring-label prompts the same knockout lowers g g from + 18 +18 to + 13 +13 and costs 0.28 0.28 nats, and adding one unit of g g brings the margin back to within 0.04 0.04 of intact.
blocks.zh: 我们敲掉16个重复的门头 并在23层的查询中加入门方向gg 在唯一标签的提示上,在通常关闭大门的地方,这个打开它. 比值在1个单位g时上升+0.58+0.58纳特,在2个单位时上升+0.90+0.90,锐读器L29h11将注意力移离水槽(0.91到0.37). 然后,我们只从20个读者的查询输入中删除了gg方向,而将其留在其他任何地方。 涨幅降至+0.43+0.43和+0.61+0.61,L29h11的沉积质量回升(0.37~0.51;0.35~0.62). 从相同的查询中去除一个同类的随机方向,没有什么变化(+0.58+0.58,+0.92+0.92,沉积质量不变). 因此,G对答案的四分之一到三分之一通过读者的询问、我们的账户所绘制的路线,其余的通过我们尚未命名的头部和MLP到达答案。 在反复出现的标签上,同一击出点将g从+18+18降至+13+13,成本为0.28 0.28纳特,加上一个g单位后,差值恢复到完好无损的0.04 0.04。

blocks.en: If the readers are many only because no single head can write enough (Proposition 2 ), then amplifying a few of them should do the work of all. We multiplied the attention output of three readers (24:21, 29:11, 22:20) at the query by two, on prompts drawn with a seed not used to choose them. The margin rises by + 0.40 +0.40 (rare labels) and + 0.25 +0.25 (symbols), against + 0.04 +0.04 for three random heads. Multiplying by four still helps, and multiplying by eight breaks the model ( − 0.56 -0.56 , − 0.84 -0.84 ). Knocking out the other seventeen readers lowers the margin by − 0.89 -0.89 and − 0.50 -0.50 , and amplifying the three by four on top of that recovers it only to − 0.46 -0.46 and − 0.44 -0.44 ; amplifying by eight makes it worse. Three amplified heads cannot stand in for seventeen. The gain bound holds and the readers’ writes do add, but the other heads carry information that these three lack. Why training spread the computation this way remains open.
blocks.zh: 如果读者数量众多,仅仅是因为没有一个单头能写得足够(提议2),那么扩展其中的几个就应该做所有人的作品. 我们在询问时将三个读者(24:21,29:11,22:20)的注意力输出乘以两个,是用一个种子不用来选择的提示。 比值上升+0.40+0.40(稀有标签)和+0.25+0.25(符号),相对于三个随机头+0.04+0.04. 乘以4仍然有帮助,乘以8打破模型(−0.56-0.56,−0.84-084),击倒其他17位读者将比值降低−0.89-0.89和−0.50-0.50,将比值放大3乘以4,只恢复到−0.46-0.46和−0.44-0.44;放大8个使差. 三个放大头不能代表十七个 但其他头头都带着这三种人缺乏的信息。 为何培训将计算推广到此方式,仍然开放。

blocks.en: Qwen and SmolLM3 add no beginning-of-sequence token, so position zero holds the prompt’s first word. Zeroing its value in the reader layers costs 0.33 0.33 nats on unique-label prompts and nothing measurable ( − 0.03 -0.03 ) on recurring ones, and the same operation on position one costs nothing in either case. Zeroing it at every layer removes the sink altogether, since the readers then put no attention there, and the margin falls by 0.76 0.76 and 0.43 0.43 . Position zero does the sink’s job, and although its content is incidental to that job, the position is not empty. Appendix refines this test and follows the part of g g ’s effect that does not pass through the readers.
blocks.zh: Quen和SmolLM3没有添加序列开始符,所以位置0占据了提示的第一个单词. 将其在阅读层中的数值零化,在独特的标签提示上成本为0.33 0.33纳特,在重复的提示上成本为0.03-0.03,在第一位置上成本为0.33纳特。 将水槽排在每一层都会完全清除,因为读者当时不注意水槽,比值下降了0.76 0.76和0.43 0.43。 零位置是水槽的工作,尽管其内容是该工作附带的,但该位置并非空的。 附录完善了这一测试,并遵循g效果中不通过读者的部分。

blocks.en: We repeated the two connection experiments on fresh draws in SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.2-3B, using each model’s own reader and duplicate-head sets and its own fitted gate direction (Table 2 ). The readers’ handoff replicates in both. SmolLM3’s twenty readers carry the whole class-flipped twin effect ( − 2.16 -2.16 against the twin’s − 2.05 -2.05 on rare-word labels, − 1.52 -1.52 against − 1.30 -1.30 on symbols; sixteen random heads give − 0.11 -0.11 / − 0.07 -0.07 ), and Llama’s twenty carry 45% / 54% of it ( − 0.86 -0.86 of − 1.92 -1.92 , − 0.46 -0.46 of − 0.86 -0.86 ). What happens after the readers differs by family. In SmolLM3, as in Qwen, holding the late attention inputs (L30–35) at their intact values removes 36% of the handoff, and holding the late MLP inputs as well removes another 27%, leaving 37% that reaches the logits directly. In Llama the holds remove nothing ( − 0.86 → − 1.02 → − 1.09 -0.86\to-1.02\to-1.09 ), so its readers reach the logits without a late relay.
blocks.zh: 我们重复了在SmolLM3-3B和Llama-3.2-3B的新鲜图纸上的两个连接实验,使用了每个模型自己的读取器和重复头套以及它自己安装的门方向(表2)。 读者的交割在两者中都有复制。 SmolLM3的20个阅读器搭载了全类飞溅的双倍效应(双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双倍双 读者因家而异后如何. 在SmolLM3中,和在Quen中一样,持有延迟关注输入(L30–35)的完好值可以消除36%的交接量,而持有延迟的MLP输入量也可以消除27%,留下直接到达对数的37%。 在拉马语中,持枪者什么也不去掉(− 0.86 → − 1.02 → − 1.09-0.86\to-1.02\to-1.09),因此其阅读器在没有延迟转发的情况下到达对数。

blocks.en: The route from the gate to the readers’ queries replicates in all three families. Adding g g at the query opens the gate in every family ( + 0.53 +0.53 / + 0.69 +0.69 nats in SmolLM3 without and with the duplicate heads knocked out, + 0.64 +0.64 / + 0.92 +0.92 in Llama). Removing g g from the readers’ queries takes back 12–46% of that in SmolLM3 and 37–79% in Llama, more at higher doses, while removing a random direction of the same norm takes back nothing ( + 0.68 +0.68 , + 0.91 +0.91 ). The step before the gate does not replicate as an effect on the margin. Knocking out the sixteen duplicate-token heads moves the gate projection in every family, in the direction the circuit predicts (on unique-label prompts by + 1.8 +1.8 units in SmolLM3 and + 4.5 +4.5 in Llama; on recurring ones by − 0.7 -0.7 and − 2.4 -2.4 ). In SmolLM3 and Llama, however, the margin does not fall with it ( + 0.90 +0.90 and − 0.39 -0.39 , where Qwen closes cleanly), because those heads also carry other information that the knockout removes. The connection from the duplicate heads into g g is therefore established at the level of the gate feature in all three models, and at the level of behaviour in Qwen only.
blocks.zh: 从大门到读者询问的路线在所有三个家庭都复制。 在查询时加g在每一个家族中打开大门(SmolLM3中的+0.53+0.53 / + 0.69+0.69 nats没有并且随着重复的头部被敲掉,+0.64+0.64 / + 0.92+0.92在Llama). 从读者的查询中移除gg可以收回SmolLM3和Llama的12–46 % , 更高剂量时则取37–79 % , 而去掉同一规范的随机方向则不能收回(+ 0.68 + 0.68,+ 0.91 + 0.91 ) 。 门前的步骤不会作为边际效应复制。 击倒16个重复式头把门投影移动到每个家庭,向电路预测方向移动(在SmolLM3和Llama的+1.8+1.8单元和+4.5+4.5单元的独特标签提示上;在反复出现的情况下,在−0.7-0.7和−2.4-2.4)。 然而,在SmolLM3和Llama中,比值并不随它而下降(+ 0.90+ 0.90和− 0.39-0.39,其中Quen的关闭是干净的),因为这些头还携带着被淘汰者删除的其他信息. 因此,从重复头到g的连接,在所有三个模型中都确立在大门特征的级别,只在Quen中确立行为水平.

blocks.en: 9 One algorithm in three models
blocks.zh: 第9条 三个模型中的一个算法

blocks.en: Three models trained by three groups on three corpora need not agree in every detail, so it helps to say in advance which details are free to vary. Some parts of the account follow from attention itself. A softmax over positions has to put its mass somewhere, so some position must serve as the sink, and a key written into a label token can only be read through that token’s keys. These parts should appear in any transformer that does the task, and if a fourth model lacked them we would count the account as falsified. Other parts are left to training: which heads do each job, how many of them there are, how strong the gate is, and in which layers the work happens. These we expect to differ, and we report them as each model’s implementation of the algorithm. We count a link as replicated when the same intervention has the same sign, with an interval that excludes zero, and the matched control stays within noise. We do not require the magnitudes to agree, and they differ by up to a factor of three.
blocks.zh: 三个团体训练的三种模式在三体型上不需要每一个细节都一致,所以它有助于预先说出哪些细节可以随意变化. 帐户的某些部分是从关注本身开始的。 在位置之上的软缩必须将其质量放置在某处,因此某些位置必须作为水槽,而刻入标签符号的密钥只能通过该符号的密钥读取. 这些部件应该出现在任何执行该任务的变压器中,如果第四个型号缺少它们,我们就会算作是伪造的账户. 其他部分留待训练:哪位头头做每份工作,有多少人,大门有多坚固,工作在哪个层次发生. 这些我们预计会有所不同,我们将它们报告为每个模型执行算法的情况。 我们把一个连接算作复制,当同一个干预有相同的标志,一个排除0的间隔,匹配的控制保持在噪音中。 我们不要求规模一致,它们最多有3个系数。

blocks.en: By this standard the account replicates in SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.2-3B (Table 4 ). The value and the key of the slot dissociate in both (Section 3 ). The read law fits 124 of 125 Llama slot-reading heads and predicts the one-slot regime more tightly than in Qwen, and the null action exists in both.
blocks.zh: 根据这一标准,该账户在SmolLM3-3B和Llama-3.2-3B中复制(表4)。 空档值和密钥在二者中都不相干(第3节)。 读法符合125个Llama插槽读头的124个,预言单片区政权比Quen更严格,无效行动在两者中都存在.

blocks.en: The implementations differ in ways worth recording. Llama’s readers sit in layers 14–27 of 28, where Qwen’s sit in 21–29 of 36. Llama’s gate is weaker: 67% of its unique-label prompts still receive a label, against 10% in Qwen. In Llama the heads that a generic induction score selects act as a withholding population. They hold the middle-layer readers on the sink, and ablating them raises the margin by about a nat (Figure 17 ). And where Qwen has two nameable query heads, SmolLM3 and Llama spread the query computation over many.
blocks.zh: 执行情况在值得记录的方式上有所不同。 Llama的读者坐落于第28层的第14–27层,第36层的第21–29层是Quen的座位. Llama的大门较弱:其67%的专用标签提示仍然收到标签,而在Quen则只有10%。 在Llama,一般上岗分数选择的负责人充当扣薪人口。 他们把中层的读者放在水槽上, 而在Quen有两个可命名的查询头的地方,SmolLM3和Llama将查询计算分布在很多地方.

blocks.en: The brakes show most clearly how a population can be invisible head by head and still exist as a set. Qwen’s 24 brakes stand out in a single-head census, but Llama’s do not. A census of the 288 Llama heads in layers 16–27 found no head whose knockout moves the margin by more than 0.12 nats, and 271 of them within ± 0.03 \pm 0.03 . Yet the sets exist. The 24 heads that the census ranks as brakes, knocked out together on a fresh twelve-demonstration draw, raise the margin by + 1.90 +1.90 [+1.12, +2.67], against + 0.12 +0.12 for 24 random heads, and the 20 heads it ranks as readers cost − 0.56 -0.56 [-1.01, -0.12], against 0.00 0.00 . At six demonstrations, where Llama’s margin is only + 0.40 +0.40 , the brake set gives + 0.57 +0.57 [+0.19, +0.93] against + 0.16 +0.16 , and the reader set’s effect is not detectable. Llama has the same two populations as Qwen, each weak head by head and strong as a set.
blocks.zh: 刹车最清楚地显示一个群体如何可以被隐形的头部,并且仍然作为一个集合存在. 但Llama没有。 对26至27层的288个Llama头的普查发现,没有任何头部的击倒比值超过0.12纳特,其中271个在±0.03\pm0.03范围内。 然而,这些组合仍然存在。 普查划分为制动组的24个头,在新的12个演示抽图上一起敲倒,将比值提高+1.90+1.90[+1.12,+2.67],对24个随机头的比值为+0.12+0.12,对20个随机头的比值为阅读器成本−0.56-0.56[-1.01,-0.12],对0.000. 在六次演示中,Llama的比值只有+0.40+0.40,制动装置给出+0.57+0.57[+0.19,+0.93]对+0.16+0.16,阅读器的比值无法检测. Llama和Quen有相同的两个种群,每个弱头和强头为一组.

blocks.en: The algorithm also assembles in a fixed order during training. Across OLMo-2 checkpoints, copying a repeated label appears first, the null action second, and the readers’ class selectivity last. The 1B model never develops the readers, which is why it never learns the task. This is the order the dependencies require, since nothing can be gated before there is something to copy, and nothing can be matched by class before the keys are written (Figure 21 , Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 该算法在训练期间还按固定顺序组装. 在OLMo-2检查站, 1B模式从不发展读者,这就是它从不学习任务的原因. 这是依存者需要的顺序,因为没有东西可以复制之前,没有东西可以被门锁,没有东西可以在密钥写入之前被类比(图21,附录F).

Named : a small set of heads is necessary and sufficient. Population : no single head is necessary, and the link is characterized by a direction with a size-matched random control. –: not run.

(b) In Qwen, adding the gate signal g g at its natural dose lowers the sink logit relative to the matching slots at the three strongest readers (red), and moves matching relative to the other slots much less (grey).
