blocks.en: 10 Natural concepts and meaningful labels
blocks.zh: 10 自然概念和有意义的标签

blocks.en: The circuit was found on batteries whose classes are surface regularities and whose labels are arbitrary tokens. A mechanism worth the name should also carry retrieval when the class is a real semantic feature and when the labels are words with meanings of their own. To test this we built one more battery, concept12n . It has four concepts that a reader would call natural (topic: animal vs. food; language: English vs. Spanish; question vs. statement; implied sentiment: good vs. bad), twelve demonstrations each, and the same prompt written four ways that differ only in the two label words: arbitrary symbols ( foo / bar ), rare words ( zorp / quil ), the concept’s own words ( animal / food ), and those words exchanged, which are the flipped labels of Wei et al. (2023) . We ran 384 prompts per model, with the same named sets and interventions as in Section 9 , and wrote down our predictions before collecting the data (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 电路是在电池上找到的,这些电池的类别是表面规律性的,其标签是任意的符号. 当类是真正的语义特征,当标签是具有自己含义的词时,一个值得命名的机制也应携带检索. 为了测试这个,我们又建造了一个电池,概念12n。 它有四个概念,一个读者会称为自然(专题:动物对食物;语言:英语对西班牙语;问题对陈述;隐含的情感:好对坏),各有十二种表现,同样的即时写作四种方式,只在两个标签词上有所不同:任意符号(foo/bar),稀有词(zorp/quil),概念本身的词(动物/食物),以及那些交换的词,这些词是魏等人的翻转标签(2023). 并记录了我们在收集数据之前的预测(附录B)。

blocks.en: With symbol and rare labels on the natural concepts, the named parts carry retrieval in all three families. In Qwen3-4B, keeping only the circuit (resampled reference) leaves the margin at intact ( − 0.05 -0.05 and + 0.96 +0.96 nats relative to intact for symbol and rare labels). In Llama and SmolLM3 it falls below intact but stays far above a random set of the same size and layers: Llama gives − 0.58 -0.58 / − 0.11 -0.11 (random − 1.5 -1.5 / − 1.3 -1.3 ), and SmolLM3 gives − 0.82 -0.82 / − 0.47 -0.47 with intervals reaching zero (random − 1.6 -1.6 / − 1.5 -1.5 ). With the mean reference all three are at or above intact. With the final sets of this section (189, 122 and 163 heads), the symbol battery of Section 8 gives the same answer in all three models: + 0.89 +0.89 / + 1.26 +1.26 in Qwen, + 0.87 +0.87 / + 1.01 +1.01 in SmolLM3 and + 0.03 +0.03 / + 0.75 +0.75 in Llama relative to intact under resampling (symbol / rare), against − 0.64 -0.64 / − 0.98 -0.98 , − 0.71 -0.71 / − 1.11 -1.11 and − 0.26 -0.26 / − 0.71 -0.71 for random sets. The retrieval stage works the same way whatever the class is.
blocks.zh: 在自然概念上带有符号和罕见的标签,命名的部分在所有三个家族中都携带检索. 在Qwen3-4B中,仅保留电路(复制参考物)留差值为完好(−0.05-0.05和+0.96+0.96 nats相对完好,用于符号和稀有标签). 在Llama和SmolLM3中,它跌落到完好无损的下方,但远远高于同样大小和层次的随机组合: Llama给出− 0.58-0.58 / − 0.11-0.11(随机− 1.5-1.5 / − 1.3-1.3),SmolLM3给出− 0.82-0.82 / − 0.47,间隔为零(随机−1.6-1.6 / − 1.5-1.5). 平均来说,这三者都完好无损。 本节的最后一组(189,122和163头),第8节的符号电池在所有三种型号中给出了相同的答案: + 0.89 + 0.89 + 0.89 / + 1.26 + 1.26 在Quen, + 0.87 + 0.87 / + 1.01 + 1.01 在 SmolLM3 和 + 0.03 + 0.03 / + 0.75 + 0.75 与 0.64-0.64 / − 0.98 , − 0.71 - 1.11-1.11 和 − 0.26-0.26 / − 0.71 在Llama 中, 相对于 0.64 - 0.64 - 0.64 − 0.94 0.98, − 0.71 - − 1.11-1.11-1.11 和 − 0.71-0. 检索阶段的工作方式与任何类相同.

blocks.en: With the concept’s own words as labels the intact margin triples, to 5.4 5.4 nats in Qwen and SmolLM3 and 4.9 4.9 in Llama. Because each prompt appears once with the natural labels and once with them exchanged, the two margins can be added and subtracted. Half their sum is the part of the margin that follows the demonstrations, which we call R R , and half their difference is the part that follows what the words mean, which we call P P . In all three models the two parts are about the same size ( R ≈ 2.7 R\approx 2.7 – 2.9 2.9 , P ≈ 2.2 P\approx 2.2 – 2.7 2.7 nats), which is why flipped labels end up near zero in a 3–4B base model, as Wei et al. (2023) found behaviourally. The meaning part does not run through the circuit. Removing the MLPs outside the named late ones costs 3.8 3.8 nats on natural labels against 1.1 1.1 on symbols, and removing the late unnamed heads, which are brakes, helps the flipped prompts ( + 0.4 +0.4 nats in SmolLM3 and Llama), as we had predicted. The prior enters through the late band, and the circuit’s readers have to win against it.
blocks.zh: 用这个概念本身的词来标注完好的比值三进制,到Quen和SmolLM3的5.4 5.4纳特和Llama的4.9. 因为每个提示会随自然标签出现一次并与它们交换一次,所以可以加减两个边. 他们的一半是示威游行之后的比值部分,我们称之为RR, 而他们的一半的区别是遵循这些话的意思,我们称之为PP。 在所有三个模型中,两部分的大小大致相同(R ≈ 2.7 R\ 2.7 – 2.9 2.9,P ≈ 2.2 P\ → 2.2 – 2.7 2.7 nats),这就是为什么翻转的标签在3–4B基模型中最终会接近零,如Wei等人. (2023)发现行为. 意思部分不贯穿电路. 将 MLP 移除到命名的后期之后, 自然标签上的成本为 3.8 3.8 纳特, 而符号上的成本为 1.1.1 纳特, 并删除后期的未命名头, 也就是刹车, 帮助了翻转的提示( + 0.4 + 0.4 纳特 在 SmolLM3 和 Llama), 正如我们所预测的。 先行者通过后行乐队进入,电路的读者必须战胜它.

blocks.en: With only the named sets kept, a quarter to a half of R R survives on natural labels (the change in R R is − 2.16 -2.16 of 2.86 2.86 nats in Qwen, − 1.50 -1.50 of 2.67 2.67 in SmolLM3 and − 1.44 -1.44 of 2.71 2.71 in Llama, with the reference matched on label pair and label set; see Appendix ). Removing the complement band by band places the remainder in the reader and copier layers rather than somewhere new, and a head-by-head screen on the natural-label prompts identifies it. In Qwen, 73 heads outside the set in layers 16–27 cross − 0.03 -0.03 nats, and the largest of them (24:30, 27:18, 24:26, 26:4) put 0.4–0.7 of their attention on the slots whose label matches the answer. A second screen of layers 28–35, which the symbol-label screen had declared closed, finds 37 more. Two of these are slot-attending readers (33:30, 29:14), and the rest are sink-attending copiers and brakes. In Llama the screen finds 52 heads at layers 11–16, its writer and first-reader stage, and in SmolLM3 15 heads, nine of them in layers 14–17 and six in 30–31. On symbol prompts these heads attend in the same way but barely matter. The slot-reading stage is thus a population whose active membership depends on what has to be copied, since a word like animal can be moved to the logits by many more heads than an arbitrary token can.
blocks.zh: 由于只保留了命名的套件,四分之一至一半的R在自然标签上生存(R的变化在Quen为2.862.86纳特中的2.16-2.16;SmolLM3为2.672.67中的1.50-1.50;Llama为2.712.71中的1.44-1.44,其参考文献与标签对称和标签组合相匹配;见附录)。 通过带子去除补充带,将剩余部分放在阅读器和复印层中而不是新的地方,自然标签提示上的逐头屏幕可以识别它. 在Quen中,73个头部在设定外的16–27层交叉—0.03–0.03纳特,其中最大的一个(24:30,27:18,24:26,26:4)将其注意力的0.4–0.7放在其标签与答案相符的槽上. 象征标签屏幕宣布关闭的第二层第28–35层屏幕又发现37层. 其中两台是插槽式阅读器(33:30,29:14),其余为槽式复印机和制动器. 在Llama,屏幕在11至16层发现了52个头,它的编剧和第一读器阶段,在SmolLM3中发现了15个头,其中9个在14至17层,6个在30至31层。 在符号上,这些头像以同样的方式出席,但不重要。 因此,读槽阶段是一个人口群体,其活跃成员取决于必须复制什么,因为像动物这样的词可以被更多的人头移动到日志上,而不是任意的标志。

blocks.en: With the screened heads added (Qwen 189 heads, Llama 163, SmolLM3 122; Figure 18 ), keeping only the circuit leaves the natural-label margin within the intact interval under resample ablation in Qwen ( − 0.16 -0.16 nats of 2.87 2.87 , interval [-0.71, +0.38]; random set − 2.89 -2.89 , no heads − 3.12 -3.12 ). In Llama and SmolLM3 it keeps 86% and 81% of R R under the mean reference ( − 0.39 -0.39 , − 0.51 -0.51 ; random − 2.4 -2.4 , − 2.8 -2.8 ). Under the mean reference Qwen overshoots ( + 0.97 +0.97 ), and its word-meaning part rises by 2.8 2.8 nats. In all three models, removing the unnamed late heads raises P P by about + 2 +2 nats, so what remains outside the set at those layers is brakes, and the prior they hold down is the meaning of the word. Every layer band from the readers onward is closed in all three models (Qwen 28–35 + 1.13 +1.13 , SmolLM3 30–35 − 0.01 -0.01 , Llama 22–27 − 0.20 -0.20 ). What SmolLM3 and Llama still lose sits in the encoder band (SmolLM3 layers 0–17 − 0.56 -0.56 , with only nine heads crossing the single-head threshold there), the same diffuse substrate we found with arbitrary labels.
blocks.zh: 加上了经过筛选的头部(Quen 189头,Llama 163头,SmolLM3 122;图18),仅将电路在Quen的再模拟衰竭下在完整间隔内留下自然标记差(−0.16-0.16纳特 2.87 2.87,间隔[-0.71,+0.38];随机设置 − 2.89-2.89,没有头−3.12-3.12)。 在Llama和SmolLM3中,它将86%和81%的R保持在平均参考值(−0.39-0.39,−0.51-0.51;随机−2.4-2.4,−2.8-2.8)。 在平均值Qwen超标(+ 0.97+ 0.97)下,其词意部分上升2.8 2.8 nats. 在所有三种模型中,移除未命名的后头将PP提升约+2+2纳特,所以这些层的设定外尚存的是制动器,它们之前的握住是这个词的意义. 所有三种模型(Quen 28–35 + 1.13 + 1.13, SmolLM3 30–35 – 0.01-0.01,Llama 22–27 – 0.20–0.20)中,来自读者的每层带都关闭。 SmolLM3和Llama仍然在编码带(SmolLM3 层 0–17– 0.56–0.56,只有9个头越过了那里的单头阈值 ) , 与我们发现的带有任意标签的分散底座相同。

blocks.en: Before the late screen we predicted that at most ten heads would cross the threshold and that the 28–35 complement would be neutral. Both predictions were wrong, and the misses are how we learned that the brake population grows with the meaning of the label. Resampled references are harsher than mean references on word labels, for reasons we give in Appendix .
blocks.zh: 在晚间屏幕之前,我们预测到,最多10个头会越过门槛,28-35的辅助将保持中立。 两种预言都是错误的,错失是我们是如何得知刹车数量随着标签的意义而增加的. 重复引用的字词标签比平均引用更严厉,

For each model, the part of the margin that follows the demonstrations ( R R , blue) and the part that follows what the label words mean ( P P , orange), intact and with only the named heads kept at the query (final sets of 189, 122 and 163 heads, with the late MLPs). The reference is the mean over same-kind prompts or a resampled same-kind prompt. The controls are a random set of the same size and layers, and no heads. blocks.en: 11 Model size and instruction tuning
blocks.zh: 11 模型大小和指令调谐

blocks.en: Everything so far was measured in base models of three to four billion parameters. Two further questions have known behavioural answers but, until now, no mechanistic ones. Wei et al. (2023) found that only large models follow flipped labels: a small model answers according to what the label word means, and a large one according to what the demonstrations say. And post-training is where every deployed model lives. We ran the same census in the Qwen3 family at 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B and 8B parameters, and in the Qwen3-4B instruct model using the base model’s heads, again writing down our predictions first (Appendix B ). Each size got its own census, and neither head identities nor the gate direction were carried over from one size to another.
blocks.zh: 到目前为止,所有东西都用30至40亿参数的基准模型来衡量。 还有两个问题已经知道行为答案,但到目前为止还没有机械答案。 Wei等人(2023年)发现只有大模型遵循翻转的标签:一个小模型根据标签单词的意思回答,一个大模型根据演示内容回答. 而后训练是每个部署的模型生活的地方. 我们用0.6B、1.7B、4B和8B参数对Quen3家族进行了同样的普查,并在Quen3-4B指示模型中使用了基准模型的头,再次将我们的预测(附录B)写下来。 每个大小都有自己的人口普查,头部身份和大门方向都没有从一个大小转到另一个。

blocks.en: Figure 19: One census at four sizes (Qwen3 base, 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B and 8B). (a) Intact margins for invented labels, natural word labels and flipped word labels. (b) Reader and brake populations: the summed effect of the heads whose single removal at the query lowers (blue) or raises (red) the margin with an interval that excludes zero; the number is the head count. (c) The brakes’ summed hold on word meaning (bars, left axis) against the flipped-label margin (line, right axis). The two rise together.

Blue is the part of the margin that follows the demonstrations ( R R ), and orange the part that follows the words’ meaning ( P P ); the band is the intact R R interval. Post-training multiplies both parts by about 2.5 and keeps their ratio. blocks.en: The census screens every head in the upper half of the model (layers 10–27 of 28 at 0.6B and 1.7B, 16–35 of 36 at 4B and 8B) by removing it alone at the query on the concept12n battery, with the per-kind mean as reference. At every size there is a reader population, made up of heads whose removal lowers the margin with an interval that excludes zero, and a brake population of heads whose removal raises it. Table 5 and Figure 19 give the counts and summed effects. The readers’ summed effect grows with size, from − 2.1 -2.1 nats at 0.6B to − 5.9 -5.9 at 8B. The brakes’ summed effect grows from + 0.8 +0.8 through + 1.2 +1.2 to + 3.8 +3.8 at 4B and then falls back to + 3.3 +3.3 at 8B, where fewer heads cross the threshold (32 against 56). We had predicted a monotone rise, and that part of the prediction missed. The largest single reader, as a fraction of the intact margin, shrinks from 22% to 18, 18 and 15%. A bigger model spreads the read over more heads, as the gain bound of Section 7 predicts when the margin to be produced grows faster than any one head’s output.
blocks.zh: 普查通过在概念12n电池的查询中单独删除模型上半部的每个头部(0.6B时为28层的10-27层,4B时为1.7B层,36层为16-35层,8B时为8B层),以人均平均值作为参考. 在所有规模上,都有读者群,由头部组成,其去除比值以零的间隔降低比值,而刹车群的去除比值提高比值。 表5和图19列出了计算结果和总结结果。 阅读器的总和效果随大小而增加,从0.6B的2.1-2.1纳特增加到8B的5.9-5.9纳特。 制动总和效应从4B时的+0.8+0.8到+1.2+1.2增长到+3.8+3.8,再回落到8B时的+3.3+3.3,在8B时,超过阈值的车头较少(32对56). 我们曾预言过单酮会上升, 而那部分预言错过了。 最大的单读器,作为完好差值的一小部分,从22%缩减到18%,18%和15%. 一个更大的模型将读数分散到更多的头部,正如第7节的收益线所预测的,当所生产的边距比任何一个头部的输出都快。

blocks.en: One thing we did not predict is that, within a layout, the parts sit at the same addresses. The two 28-layer models share their top brake, 22:7 ( + 0.27 +0.27 and + 0.43 +0.43 nats), their second, 26:7, and nine reader positions. The two 36-layer models share their five strongest readers (29:11, 24:29, 28:0, 24:30, 24:22) and their five strongest brakes (25:30, 28:23, 31:30, 25:14, 33:21). From these runs we cannot tell whether this comes from initialisation, from data order or from something about the task.
blocks.zh: 我们没有预料到的一件事是,在一个布局范围内,零件坐落在同一个地址. 两种28层的车型共用其顶部制动装置,22:7(+0.27+0.27和+0.43+0.43纳特),其第二,26:7和9个读者位置. 两种36层的车型共享其5种最强的阅读器(29:11,24:29,28:0,24:30,24:22)及其5种最强的制动器(25:30,28:23,31:30,25:14,33:21). 从这些运行中,我们无法分辨这是来自初始化,数据顺序还是关于任务的东西.

blocks.en: For each size we fitted the gate direction from that model’s own pairs of unique- and recurring-label prompts (Section 5 ). The direction separates held-out pairs perfectly at every layer of the upper half in all four models, and its size relative to the residual at the arrow peaks in the last third of the stack in all four (layer 22 of 28 at 0.6B and 1.7B, 23 of 36 at 4B, 24–34 of 36 at 8B). Adding the fitted direction at the query arrow of unique-label prompts, at the dose the model itself uses, raises their label margin by + 1.75 +1.75 (0.6B), + 0.95 +0.95 (1.7B) and + 1.11 +1.11 (8B) nats. At 4B, where the intact unique-label margin is already + 0.24 +0.24 , the single dose gives + 0.25 +0.25 with an interval reaching zero, and the double dose gives + 0.78 +0.78 . A random direction of the same norm moves the margin by at most 0.2 0.2 in the wrong direction. Taking the direction away from recurring-label prompts lowers their margin by 1.35 1.35 , 0.69 0.69 , 0.72 0.72 and 1.07 1.07 nats at a single dose (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B), and by 2.9 2.9 , 1.7 1.7 , 1.8 1.8 and 3.0 3.0 at double. Two of our predictions failed here. We expected a single dose to clear zero at every size, and 4B did not. We also expected the double dose to beat the single one everywhere, but at 8B they tie ( 1.10 1.10 against 1.11 1.11 ), because adding the direction saturates there while removing it still has twice the effect.
blocks.zh: 对于每个尺寸,我们从该型号自己的对独特和反复出现的标签提示(第5节)安装了大门方向。 方向在所有四个模型的上半部的每一层完美地分离出悬浮对子,其大小相对于所有四个模型中最后三分之一堆积的箭头顶部的残存(第28层为0.6B,第1.7B,第36层为23层为4B,第36层为24-34层为8B). 在唯一标签提示符的查询箭头上添加安装的方向,在模型本身使用的剂量时,它们的标签边距会提高+1.75+1.75(0.6B),+0.95+0.95(1.7B)和+1.11+1.11(8B)纳茨. 在4B,完好无缺的独特标签比值已经为+0.24+0.24时,单剂量给+0.25+0.25,间隔达到0,双剂量给+0.78+0.78. 同一规范的随机方向将比值移动最多0.2 0.2误向. 远离反复出现的标签提示将单剂量时的比值降低1.351.35、0.69 0.69、0.72 0.72和1.071.07纳特(0.6B、1.7B、4B、8B),双剂量降低2.9、1.71.7、1.81.8和3.0。 我们的两个预测在这里失败了。 我们预计每一次剂量都为零,4B没有。 我们还期望双剂量能击败单剂量,但8B时它们会打平(1.10 1.10对1.11 1.11),因为在那里增加方向饱和度,同时去除它仍有两倍的效果.

blocks.en: At every size, the paired natural and flipped prompts give the part of the margin that follows the demonstrations ( R R ) and the part that follows the words ( P P ). Both grow with size, but R R grows faster. P / R P/R falls from 1.03 1.03 at 0.6B through 0.92 0.92 and 0.88 0.88 to 0.73 0.73 at 8B, and the flipped-label margin rises from − 0.03 -0.03 through + 0.14 +0.14 and + 0.35 +0.35 to + 1.05 +1.05 nats. This is the curve of Wei et al. (2023) , reproduced inside a single family, and the census shows what moves it. The brakes on word meaning, the heads whose removal raises P P , hold down 1.7 1.7 nats at 0.6B, 2.1 2.1 at 1.7B, 3.6 3.6 at 4B and 4.0 4.0 at 8B (23, 24, 54 and 74 heads). Of all the quantities in the census, this sum is the one that rises in step with the flipped-label margin at every size, and the reader population that carries R R grows alongside it. The gate does not track size in this way. Its dose effect is of the same order at every size (Table 5 ), so the gate is a part present everywhere but not the lever that moves the curve.
blocks.zh: 在每个大小上,成对的自然和翻转的提示给出了在演示之后的边距部分(R R)和在文字之后的部分(P P ). 两者都随大小增长,但RR增长更快. P/R P/R从1.03 1.03的0.6B下降到0.92 0.92和0.88 0.88到0.73 0.73的8B,翻转的标签比值从−0.03-0.03升至+0.14+0.14和+0.35+0.35升至+1.05+1.05纳特. 这是魏等人(2023年)的曲线,在一个家族内部复制,人口普查显示是什么动了它. 字义上的刹车,其移除头抬起PP,在0.6B时按1.71.7纳特,在1.7B时按2.1 2.1,在4B时按3.63.6,在8B时按4.0(23、24、54和74头)。 在人口普查的所有数量中,这个总和是随着每个大小的翻转的标签比值同步上升的,而携带RR的读者人口也同时增长. 大门没有用这种方式追踪大小。 它的剂量效应在每一个大小上都有相同的顺序(表5),所以门是随处可见的一部分,但不是移动曲线的杠杆.

blocks.en: The picture that emerges is a balance of strengths. In a small model the readers and the word-meaning prior are about equally strong, so exchanging the labels cancels the demonstrations. In a large model the readers out-pull the prior, and the brakes the model has grown hold the prior down further. Two details of our prediction missed: we expected the 1.7B flipped margin to be negative (it is + 0.14 +0.14 , with an interval crossing zero) and the 0.6B rare-label margin to be below 0.3 0.3 nats (it is 0.62 0.62 ). The monotone parts of the prediction held.
blocks.zh: 出现的情况是力量的平衡。 在小模型中,读者和字面意思前作大致相同,所以交换标签可以取消示威。 在一个大模型中,阅读器会把前置的推开,而制动器则已经进一步将前置的推开。 我们的预测错过了两个细节:我们预计1.7B的翻转比值为负(它为+0.14+0.14,间隔跨度为0),0.6B的稀标签比值低于0.3 0.3纳特(它为0.62 0.62. 预言中的单调部分被持有.

blocks.en: Qwen3-4B instruct has the same architecture as its base model, so the base model’s 189-head set can be carried into it unchanged, with no re-identification. The set still carries retrieval. On the symbol battery the 189 heads alone, with a resampled reference, are at or above intact ( + 0.43 +0.43 / + 1.29 +1.29 nats relative to intact for symbol and rare labels; base model + 0.89 +0.89 / + 1.26 +1.26 ), a random set of the same size and layers loses 0.66 0.66 / 1.15 1.15 , and removing the 189 heads costs exactly what removing every head costs ( − 0.61 -0.61 / − 1.00 -1.00 against − 0.60 -0.60 / − 1.00 -1.00 ). The base model’s gate direction, without refitting, is positive at layer 23 on all 144 prompts.
blocks.zh: Quen3-4B指令的架构与其基础模型相同,因此基础模型的189头集可以不加改变地携带到其中,没有重新识别. 套装仍带有检索功能. 在符号电池上,仅189个头部,加上重印的参照物,就处于或以上完好无损(+0.43+0.43 / + 1.29 + 1.29 nats相对完好无损的符号和稀有标签;基型+0.89+0.89 / + 1.26+1.26),同一大小和层层的随机组损失0.66 0.66 / 1.15 1.15,去除189个头部的精确成本,去除每一头部成本(− 0.61 - 0.61 / - 1.00 - 1.00 / - 1.60 – 1.00),基型的门方向在所有144个速率的23层均是正的。

blocks.en: What post-training changed is the gain (Figure 20 ). With word labels both parts of the margin are about 2.5 2.5 times larger ( R = 7.30 R=7.30 , P = 6.75 P=6.75 ; base 2.87 2.87 and 2.52 2.52 ), and their ratio is unchanged ( 0.92 0.92 against 0.88 0.88 ), so the instruct model still half-follows meaning on flipped labels, as Wei et al. (2023) reported for instruction-tuned models. We had predicted that P P would rise and R R would stay flat, but both rose. The extra gain on meaning is held down by the unnamed heads of layers 16–27, whose removal now raises P P by 4.9 4.9 nats (in the base model, about 2 2 ), and the 189 heads keep 79% of R R (in the base model, all of it). Post-training did not rewire the readers. It added braking in the population around them.
blocks.zh: 培训后的变化是收益(图20)。 字形标签的边距两部分大约2.5倍大(R=7.30R=7.30,P=6.75P=6.75;基数2.872.87和2.522.52),其比例不变(0.920.92对0.880.88),因此指示模型在翻转的标签上仍然有半跟随意义,如魏等人. (2023年)报告了指导调整模型。 我们预计PP会上升,RR会保持平稳,但两者都上升. 意义上的额外收益被16–27层的无名头所压低,现在移除这些头将P提升4.9 4.9纳特(在基座模型中约为2,2),189头保留了79%的RR(在基座模型中,全部). 培训后没有重新给读者打线。 它增加了周围人群的刹车.

blocks.en: Table 5: One census at four sizes (Qwen3 base, concept12n , 384 prompts each, upper-half heads removed one at a time at the query). Readers: removal lowers the margin, with an interval that excludes zero; brakes: removal raises it. R R and P P are the parts of the word-label margin that follow the demonstrations and the meaning. Gate dose: change in the unique-label margin when the size’s own fitted direction is added at the query arrow at the model’s own dose and at twice that dose, and change in the recurring-label margin when it is taken away. 0.6B and 1.7B screen layers 10–27 (288 heads); 4B and 8B screen layers 16–35 (640 heads).
blocks.zh: 表5:一次人口普查,共4个大小(Quen3基数,概念12n,384个提示,上半头在查询时一次移除一个). 阅读器:移除会降低边距,间隔排除0;制动器:移除会提高边距. R R和P P是词标签边框中随演示和意义而来的部分. 门剂量:在模型本身的剂量和该剂量的两倍时,在查询箭头上加上尺寸本身的装配方向时,改变唯一标签边,在取走时改变反复出现的标签边。 0.6B和1.7B屏幕层10–27(288头);4B和8B屏幕层16–35(640头).

blocks.en: 12 Building the circuit
blocks.zh: 12 建造线路

blocks.en: A mechanism found by taking a network apart should also be something one can build. We built this one twice: once by writing the weights of a small transformer by hand so that it implements exactly the circuit of Figure 2 , and once by training a small transformer on the task from scratch and looking for the parts.
blocks.zh: 通过拆分网络找到的机制也应该是人们可以建立起来的。 我们用手写出一个小变压器的重量 以便它精确地执行图2的电路 一次从零开始训练一个小变压器 寻找零件

blocks.en: The hand-built model is attention-only, with three layers and a residual stream made of named blocks (class direction, label identity, position, token type, duplicate flag, gate, slot key and query code). Layer 1 holds the writers, which attend from each label token back to its sentence and copy the class into the slot-key block, and from the query arrow back to the query sentence into the query-code block. It also holds a duplicate detector that marks any label token whose identity appeared earlier. Layer 2 holds one pooling head, which averages the duplicate flags over the label positions into the gate block at the arrow. Layer 3 holds the readers. Their query is the query code plus the gate, their keys are the slot keys together with one fixed sink key at position 0, and their values are the label identities, which the unembedding reads out. Nothing is trained.
blocks.zh: 手工建造的模型是只注意的,有三层和由命名的块(类方向,标签身份,位置,令牌类型,重复旗,门,槽键和查询码)组成的残流. 第1层持有写法,它从每个标签符号返回到它的句子,把类复制到槽键块,从查询箭头返回到查询句子进入查询码块. 它还持有一个重复的探测器,标记任何身份出现较早的标签符号. 第2层有一个集合头,它平均将标签位置上的重复旗帜射入箭头的门块。 第三层有读者 他们的查询是查询码加闸门,他们的密钥是插槽密钥加上位置0的一个固定的汇密钥,他们的值是标签身份,未嵌入者读出. 没有什么是训练。

blocks.en: On the slotgate prompts the hand-built model reproduces Proposition 1 exactly (largest deviation 10 − 16 10^{-16} , since the law is the softmax it was built from), and it reproduces the behaviour of the gate described in Section 5 . On unique-label prompts the sink takes 0.67 of the readers’ attention and the margin is + 0.24 +0.24 , and adding g g empties the sink and raises the margin to + 0.73 +0.73 . On recurring-label prompts (margin + 0.83 +0.83 , sink 0.02), knocking out the duplicate detector sends 0.54 of the attention to the sink ( + 0.39 +0.39 ), adding g g back rescues it ( + 0.84 +0.84 ), and removing g g from the readers’ queries undoes the rescue ( + 0.39 +0.39 ). Knocking out the writers leaves nothing to read ( 0.00 0.00 ). Capping each reader’s output as in Proposition 2 makes the margin grow with the number of readers (0.16, 0.49, 1.25 and 2.53 nats for 1, 3, 8 and 20 heads). This establishes sufficiency, in the sense that these parts, wired this way, produce the law and the gate. It says nothing yet about whether a trained model would choose them.
blocks.zh: 在槽口上提示手工建造的模型完全复制了提议1(最大的偏差10 - 16 10 - 16),因为法律是它所建的软马克斯),它复制了第5节描述的门的行为. 在唯一标签上提示,水槽需要0.67个读取器的注意力,比值为+ 0.24+0.24,加g 空置水槽,将比值提高到+ 0.73+0.73。 在反复出现的标签提示上(边距+0.83+0.83,沉积0.02),敲出重复的探测器将注意力的0.54分送到沉积处(+0.39+0.39),加上g背部救援(+0.84+0.84),从读者的询问中移除g可以解除救援(+0.39+0.39 ) 。 敲出编剧留下的任何东西可以读(0.00 0. 与提议2一样, 这确立了充足性,即这些部件以这种方式接线,产生法律和大门。 还没有提到训练有素的模特儿是否会选择他们

blocks.en: We trained a four-layer, eight-head Llama-architecture model (hidden size 256, 3.4M parameters) on a synthetic version of the task. The vocabulary has 48 word tokens, each carrying two of eight latent classes. A sentence is three words that share exactly one class, 32 arbitrary label tokens are redrawn for every prompt, and each prompt has two to six demonstrations followed by a query. We used two training distributions with three seeds each: a mix of unique-label and recurring-label prompts, and recurring-label prompts only. The task is learned abruptly between 8k and 30k steps, and by 40k steps every run answers both kinds of prompt with a margin near 10 nats.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了一个四层,八头的Llama-architecture模型(隐藏大小256,3.4M参数)来合成任务. 词汇有48个词符,每个词符包含8个潜伏类中的2个. 一个句子是3个完全共用一个类的词,32个任意的标签符符被重新绘制为每个提示,每个提示符有2到6个演示,然后是查询. 我们使用了两个训练分布,每个种子有三个种子:一个是独特的标签和反复出现的标签提示的组合,另一个是重复性的标签提示。 任务在8k到30k步之间突如其来地学习,40k步每跑一次都会以接近10纳特的比值回答两种速率.

blocks.en: The parts we could look for with the same tools are present. Swapping a slot’s residual stream at the writer layers moves the answer by 7–11 nats in every seed, and class-flip attribution finds one or two reader heads in the last layer. (A model this small needs no population, because its single heads clear the gain bound.) The gate, however, is absent under both distributions. The direction separating unique- from recurring-label prompts at the arrow has held-out sign accuracy of 0.45–0.62 in all six runs, steering along it does nothing consistent, and the two kinds of prompt are answered with the same margin (8.8–10.7 nats).
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的工具可以寻找的部分已经存在。 在写作层的槽余流将每个种子的答案移动7~11纳特,而类-flip属性在最后一个层中找到一两个读取器头. (这个小的模型不需要人口, 因为它的单头清除了收益约束。 ) 然而,这两处分布均没有大门。 在箭头将独特和反复出现的标记提示区分开来的方向,在所有6次运行中都保持了0.45–0.62的标记精度,沿它方向旋转并没有什么一致之处,两种提示以同样的比值(8.8–10.7 nats)回答.

blocks.en: In hindsight our account predicts this. The small model has no prior to fall back on, and in its training data the unique-label mapping is always consistent, so retrieving is always right and nothing selects for a gate. We think the pretrained models have a gate because, against the language prior, a set of labels that never repeat does not certify a consistent mapping. The matching test is a third training distribution in which every unique-label prompt carries a fresh, unpredictable query label, so that recurrence is the only sign that retrieval will pay off. Four of five seeds learned the task, and in all four a gate appeared. Recurring-label prompts are answered with a margin of 8.7–9.1 nats and unique-label ones with 1.8–2.3, whereas under the other two distributions both kinds get 8.8–10.7. The recurring-minus-unique direction at the arrow in layer 2 is decodable on held-out prompts at 0.81–1.00 (0.45–0.62 in the controls), and steering along it by one natural gap moves the answer. Pushing a recurring prompt toward “unique” drops its margin from 9 to 0.7 and 1.1 in two seeds (a random direction of the same norm gives 7.0 and 5.8), and pushing a unique prompt toward “recurring” raises it from 2.3 to 8.0 in one seed and from 2.0 to 4.0 in another (random: 1.8 and 0.9). Which side can be steered varies by seed (Table in Appendix ). In the mix and recurring-only controls the same push changes nothing, with margins moving by less than 0.1. A gate forms when, and only when, retrieval on unique-label prompts is penalised in training. This is the first causal evidence we know of for why the pretrained models have one.
blocks.zh: 事后,我们的账户预测这一点。 小模型在恢复前没有恢复,在其训练数据中,独有的标签映射总是一致的,因此检索总是对的,没有东西选择一个门. 我们认为,预先训练过的模型有一个门,因为与前面的语言相反,一套从未重复的标签不能证明一个一致的映射. 匹配测试是第三个训练分布,每个独有的标签提示都带有新鲜的,不可预测的查询标签,这样重现是唯一能让检索得到回报的标志. 5个种子中有4个知道这个任务,在所有4个种子中都出现了一个大门. 重复式标签提示的回答比值为8.7-9.1纳特,独特的标签提示的回答比值为1.8-2.3,而在另外两种分布下,两种标签的回答都是8.8-10.7。 第2层箭头的反复-最小-唯一方向在0.81-1.00(控制器中为0.45-0.62)被扣动的提示上可以解码,并用一个自然的缺口来引导答案。 将重复出现的“独特”迅速率从9降至0.7,在两种种子中降至1.1(同一规范的随机方向给7.0和5.8),在“经常”方面推出独特的迅速率,使一种种子从2.3降至8.0,另一种种子从2.0降至4.0(随机:1.8和0.9)。 哪一面可按种子而有所不同(附录中的表格)。 在混音和重现性控制中,相同的推力没有变化,边距移动小于0.1. 在培训中惩罚在专用标签提示上检索的大门。 这是我们知道的第一个因果证据, 说明为什么预先训练的模型有一个。

blocks.en: 13 Related work
blocks.zh: 13 相关工作

blocks.en: One line of work asks what function few-shot ICL implements, abstracting away from the network. Garg et al. (2022) train transformers to learn simple function classes in context, and Akyürek et al. (2022) and von Oswald et al. (2022) show that, for linear regression, the computation can be read as gradient descent or ridge regression carried out by attention. These results describe the input–output map on synthetic tasks. We study a pretrained model on text and ask which heads carry out which step, and the answer we find is a lookup in a memory, with no step that resembles a gradient update.
blocks.zh: 一行工作询问什么功能是少镜头的ICL执行器,抽象出网络. Garg等人(2022年)在上下文中学习简单函数类的列车变压器,Akyürek等人(2022年)和von Oswald等人(2022年)显示,对于线性回归,计算可以被读作是梯度下降或通过关注进行的脊面回归. 这些结果描述了关于合成任务的输入输出图. 我们研究一个在文本上经过预先训练的模型,问哪个头执行哪个步骤,我们发现的答案是在记忆中进行检索,没有步骤类似于梯度更新.

blocks.en: Cho et al. (2024) give a three-step outline of an ICL inference circuit in which label tokens store task information that a later head reads, and Zheng et al. (2024) and Hu et al. (2025) identify label words as the local carriers of that information. We add what the slot holds and on which side of attention, which heads write it and at what depth, and what switches the read on. Kim (2025) dissociate task schema from binding, whereas our dissociation is between a single label token’s keys and values. Jiao et al. (2026) study what happens when demonstrations conflict, and the brakes we describe are the population that decides which of two recent labels wins.
blocks.zh: Cho等人(2024年)给出了ICL推论电路的三步轮廓,标签符存储后头读到的任务信息,郑等人(2024年)和胡等人. (2025) 将标签词确定为该信息的当地载体。 我们增加插槽的位置 注意的哪一边 头部 深度 读数的开关 Kim( 2025 年) 将任务计划与约束区分开来, 而我们的分离则介于单一标签符键和值之间 。 廖等编. (2026)研究示威冲突时会发生什么,我们描述的刹车是决定最近两个标签中哪一个获得胜利的人口.

blocks.en: Hendel et al. (2023) and Todd et al. (2023) extract a task or function vector from a few heads’ outputs at the query. Our query code is the same kind of object seen from the side of its consumers: two heads write it, and it lies in the span of the readers’ match functionals and not along any one reader’s weight-space probe. Olsson et al. (2022) established induction heads as the copying mechanism of in-context learning and described the phase change in which they appear. Our duplicate-token detectors are the first half of that circuit put to a second use, producing the repeat signal that the gate pools. The readers are induction heads whose match is on a class feature, and the emergence order we observe extends the induction-head phase change by two further stages. Yu & Ananiadou (2024) locate recency in query–key similarity to label positions; we find the same bias in the readers’ attention, together with the population that cancels it.
blocks.zh: Hendel等人(2023年)和Todd等人著. (2023) 在查询时从几个头的输出中提取任务或函数向量 。 我们的查询码是其消费者所看到的同类物体:两个头写它,它位于读者匹配功能的跨度,而不是在任何一个读者的重量空间探测器上。 奥尔松等人. (2022)建立了上岗主管作为内文学习的复制机制,并描述了他们出现的阶段变化. 我们的重复式探测器是电路的上半部, 用于第二次使用, 产生重复的信号,即闸门集合。 阅读者是上岗头目,他们的比赛在课堂上进行,我们观察到的出现顺序将上岗头目阶段的变化又延长了两个阶段. Yu & Ananiadou (2024年) 在查询中找到后置性 — — 和标签位置相似; 我们发现读者和取消它的人口在注意力中也有同样的偏差。

blocks.en: Wang et al. (2022) found negative name-mover heads that write against the answer, and McDougall et al. (2023) describe copy suppression as a general function of such heads. Our brakes are a population with that sign and a measurable job, which is to calibrate the model against recency. Xiao et al. (2023) describe the attention sink as a position that absorbs attention; we give it a function in retrieval, as the null position whose logit the gate controls.
blocks.zh: Wang et al. (2022)发现负名- mover头写作反对答案,McDougall et al. (2023)将拷贝压制描述为这类头的一般功能. 我们的刹车是一个带有这个标志和可以衡量的工作的人口,那就是校准模型,使其不重复。 萧等. (2023)将注意力槽描述为能吸收注意力的位置;我们赋予它在检索中的一个功能,作为登录闸门控制的无效位置.

blocks.en: Activation patching descends from causal mediation analysis ( Vig et al., 2020 ) and the locating experiments of Meng et al. (2022) , and Hanna et al. (2023) and Nanda et al. (2023) use it to recover full circuits for arithmetic tasks. Wang et al. (2022) evaluate a circuit by faithfulness, completeness and minimality. Our exact accounting checks the decomposition prompt by prompt, our circuit-only runs test faithfulness, and our population results are where minimality fails, for a reason we can state. Quirke (2026) stress-test attribution with same-answer controls, which we use throughout. Chen et al. (2024) , and the objection that “circuit” bundles together sparsity, localisability and modularity ( LessWrong post, 2026 ) , frame the question that our split between components and populations answers (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 激活补丁从因果调解分析(Vig等人,2020年)和Meng等人的定位实验(2022年),Hanna等人(2023年)和Nanda等人(2023年)利用它来恢复算术任务的全电路. 王等编. (2022年)通过忠诚,完整性和最小度来评价一个电路. 我们精确的会计检查 迅速分解的速率, 我们的电路 运行测试的忠诚度, 我们的人口结果 是最小的失败, 原因我们可以说明。 Quirke (2026) 压力测试归属 具有相同的回答控制,我们一直使用. Chen等人(2024年),以及“电路”将垃圾、地方性与模块性(LessWrong position, 2026年)捆绑在一起的反对意见, 提出了我们把组件和人口分开的问题(附录)。

blocks.en: 14 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The account covers a narrow setting, and we want its boundary to be visible. It describes two-class label retrieval and function selection with short sentences and single-token labels, at up to twelve demonstrations, in three base models of three to four billion parameters. We re-found the parts and the gate at four sizes of one family (Section 11 ), and the base model’s heads still carry retrieval after post-training. The account does not cover instruction following, long-form tasks or binding among many classes, and our sizes stop at 8B. Within that boundary every link has an intervention and a control behind it. Outside it we have not looked.
blocks.zh: 这个账户覆盖一个狭小的设置,我们希望它的边界可以被看到. 它描述了双类标签检索和功能选择,带有短句和单键标签,在最多12个演示时,以3至40亿参数的3个基本模型进行. 我们以一个家庭的四大尺寸(第11节)重新发现了零件和大门,而基模的头部在训练后仍然带有回收物。 该账户不包含后面的指令,长式任务或在许多类中绑定,我们的大小止于8B. 在这个边界内,每一个环节都有干预和控制。 外面我们没看

blocks.en: Some of our predictions did not hold, and the failures were among the more informative results. The read law does not extrapolate to longer prompts. Empirically, a head’s null mass and its total matching mass stay roughly constant as matching slots are added, so the added slots share what was already there, and the law we fitted at twelve demonstrations had absorbed this saturation into its constants. We can describe this but cannot yet explain it. The fitted parameters are not separately identifiable ( n rest n_{\mathrm{rest}} and e L sink e^{L_{\mathrm{sink}}} enter only through their sum), so why each head’s budgets stay fixed is a question that needs its own answer. We also expected that fine-tuning on many-shot prompts, where recency costs accuracy, would strengthen the brakes. Instead, 400 steps of LoRA tripled the readers’ necessity and left the brakes where they were ( + 1.32 +1.32 against + 1.44 +1.44 nats), so where the brakes come from in training is still open. A third test, knocking out the seven largest direct movers, had the predicted sign but an interval that includes zero.
blocks.zh: 我们的一些预测没有站住脚,这些失败是比较翔实的结果之一。 读法不推断为更长的提示. 经验是,头部的无质量及其总的匹配质量随着匹配插槽的加入而大致保持不变,所以添加的插槽分享了已经存在的东西,而我们在12个演示中安装的法则将这种饱和吸收到它的常数中。 我们可以描述这一点,但还不能解释。 安装的参数无法单独识别( n rest_ n_{\ mathrm{rest}}) 和 e L 沉入 e^{L_{\ mathrm{ sink } 因此为什么每个首长的预算都固定下来, 我们还预计,对多镜头的提示进行微调,在调整费用准确的情况下,将加强制动。 相反,400步的LORA使阅读器的必要性翻了两番,并离开了刹车的位置(+1.32+1.32对+1.44+1.44纳特),因此在训练中来自刹车的地方仍然开放. 第三次测试,击出七个最大的直接移动器, 有了预言的标志,但间隔包括0。

blocks.en: The most general lesson, we think, concerns the split between named components and populations. Where a step needs little output gain, the model concentrates it: two heads compute the query’s class, sixteen detect repeats, and three value groups carry most of the label’s identity. Where a step needs more gain than one head’s W O ​ V W_{OV} can provide, the model sums over many heads, and no single head is necessary. The populations are still circuits in the ordinary sense. Each has a definite input direction and a definite output direction, and those directions are specific when compared with random subspaces of the same dimension. What a population lacks is a single responsible head, and Proposition 2 explains why it cannot have one. We would suggest that an account of any transformer behaviour say, for each step, whether the model concentrated or summed, and give the population-level object where it summed. This is also our answer to the worry that “circuit” presupposes sparsity. In our account, how sparse each step is depends on the gain that step requires.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,最一般的教训涉及点名成分和人口之间的分裂。 当一个步骤需要很少的输出收益时,模型集中它:两个头计算查询的类,十六个检测重复,三个值组携带标签的大部分身份. 如果一个步骤需要比一个头的W O V QQOV 更多的收益,模型总和会超过许多头,而不需要一个头。 人口仍然是普通意义上的电路。 每个方向都有明确的输入方向和明确的输出方向,这些方向与同维度的随机子空间相比是具体的. 民众缺乏的是一个负责的单一头目,而提议2解释了为何不能有一个头. 我们建议,对于任何变压器的行为, 都说,无论模型是集中的还是归纳的, 并给出一个集合的物体。 这也是我们对 " 电路 " 预先假定是垃圾的担忧的答案。 在我们的叙述中,每一步骤多么稀少取决于该步骤所需的收益。

blocks.en: A model that reads a memory in its prompt also needs a way not to read it, and the softmax supplies one for free, in the form of a position that every head can fall back on. In Qwen and SmolLM3 that position holds the prompt’s first token, so being the sink is a learned role and the position is not empty. Removing its value at every layer leaves the readers nowhere to put the attention they do not spend, and unique-label prompts, where not reading is the right action, get worse by 0.4–0.8 nats. We suspect this is why attention sinks are found in so many models, and why the gate acts on the readers’ queries and nowhere else. The query is the one place where a prompt-level signal can reach the only lever there is.
blocks.zh: 一个在即时读取记忆的模型也需要一种不读的方法,软max免费供应一个,其形式是每个头都能够倒回的位置. 在 Quen 和 SmolLM3 中, 这个位置持有 prote 的第一个符号, 因此作为 shink 是一个学到了的角色, 位置不是空的 。 在每一层消除其价值,读者都无处去关注他们没有花费的注意力,唯一标签提示,如果不阅读是正确的行为,则会以0.4-0.8 nats变得更加糟糕。 我们怀疑这就是为什么在如此众多的模型中发现注意力沉积的原因, 查询是快速级信号能够到达那里唯一杠杆的地方.

blocks.en: Some consequences reach beyond the setting we studied, though they rest on one family of tasks and should be read with that in mind.
blocks.zh: 一些后果超出了我们研究的范围,尽管它们依赖于一个任务家族,因此应当铭记这一点。

blocks.en: In this setting, in-context learning is retrieval. We found no step that resembles fitting a rule or taking a gradient step. The model binds each label to the class of the sentence before it and looks that class up when the query arrives. What a model can learn from examples is then limited by what its encoder already represents. In our batteries, a class that was not linearly readable at the arrow (parity, the third letter of a word, digit rules) never became a usable key, however many demonstrations the prompt held, and writing the key in by hand raised accuracy on such prompts from 50 to 71%. The link is correlational, but it suggests a cheap diagnostic for few-shot tasks: probe for the class at the arrow before writing the prompt.
blocks.zh: 在此设置中,内文学习是检索. 我们没有发现任何步骤 类似一个规则或采取梯度步骤。 模型将每个标签绑在它之前的句子的类上,并在查询到来时查找该类. 一个模型能从实例中学到什么,然后被它的编码器已经代表什么所限制. 在我们的电池中,一个在箭头上无法线性读取的类(平和,一个单词的第三个字母,数字规则)从未成为可用的密钥,然而,许多演示都握着,用手将密钥写在这样的密钥上,精确度从50%提高到71%。 链接是相关联的,但建议对几发任务进行廉价的诊断:在写出提示之前先对箭头的类进行探测.

blocks.en: The behaviour that Wei et al. (2023) describe as appearing with scale appears here without any new component. Readers, brakes and a working gate are all present at 0.6B, and what changes with size is the balance between the population that follows the demonstrations and the population that holds down what the label words mean. If other abilities that seem to switch on with scale work the same way, they would be better understood by measuring how the strengths of existing parts shift with size than by searching for a part that is missing in small models. Post-training, at least in the one model we examined, also worked on gain. It left the base model’s circuit in place and changed how strongly its parts pull, which is encouraging for anyone hoping that mechanisms found in base models will carry over to the models people actually use.
blocks.zh: 魏等人(2023年)描述的随规模出现的行为在此出现,没有任何新的成分. 阅读器,制动器和一个工作闸门都存在0.6B,随着规模的变化,是示威游行之后的人口和坚持标签词的意思的人口之间的平衡. 如果其他能力似乎也以同样的方式与规模工作相切换,那么,比起寻找小模型中缺失的部分,通过衡量现有部件的长处如何随大小变化来更好地了解这些能力。 后训练,至少在我们所研究的一个模式中,也是有收益的。 它留下了基模型的电路,并改变了其零件的拉力,这对希望基模型中发现的机制能够传承给实际使用的模型的人来说是令人鼓舞的。

blocks.en: Finally, the model carries a low-dimensional signal that says whether its prompt contains a mapping worth following, and we can add that signal or take it away. Whether a model trusts its context or its training is a question that comes up in retrieval-augmented generation, in prompts that try to override a model with demonstrations, and whenever a user supplies information that contradicts what the model learned. Our results suggest that, at least for labelled demonstrations, part of this decision is made by a few identifiable directions and populations, which could be measured and perhaps adjusted directly.
blocks.zh: 最后,模型带有一个低维信号,说明它的提示是否包含一个值得跟踪的映射,我们可以添加这个信号或者把它拿走. 一个模型是信任其上下文还是信任其训练,这个问题出现在检索的生成中,在试图用演示来推翻一个模型的提示中,以及当一个用户提供与模型学到的东西相矛盾的信息时. 我们的结果表明,至少对于有标签的示威,这一决定的一部分是由几个可以识别的方向和人口作出的,可以加以衡量,也许可以直接调整。

blocks.en: It has not escaped our notice that the gate we have described, a signal that tells the model whether its prompt holds a memory worth reading, suggests a possible mechanism by which a language model decides whether to consult its context at all, before other heads weigh what the context says against what the model already knows.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,我们所描述的大门(这个信号告诉模型它的迅速是否具有值得阅读的记忆)暗示了一种可能的机制,一个语言模型通过这个机制来决定是否完全参考其上下文,然后在其他头像对照模型已经知道的内容来权衡上下文。

Every axis that failed to bind (parity, third letter, letter set, digit rules) is one that the model never represents linearly at the arrow, at any layer. Language, by contrast, becomes linear by layer 8 and binds weakly through layers 10–20, and topic, sentiment and implied meaning become linear by layer 13 and bind through layers 21–29. Adding the gate to a prompt that does not bind changes nothing. For assembly from parts, we wrote the task direction u u into the query-class slots at layer 16 and at the query of a parity prompt. This raises accuracy from 50% to 71% (question 38% → \to 58%, vowel 50% → \to 71%), while key-only, query-only and random directions stay within ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 , and writing into the wrong-class slots hurts. SmolLM3 reproduces this at a model-specific dose. For the same-answer control, handoffs from a same-class twin of the same length move the answer by at most 0.06 nats. Appendix D Why the all-layer label-token handoff must reproduce the swap Let two prompts A A and B B have the same length and identical tokens except at a set of positions S S (here the label tokens). Run the model on B B and, at every layer, replace the keys and values computed at the positions in S S by those from the run on A A . We claim that every position outside S S then carries exactly its A A -run residual stream at every layer, so the logits at the query equal those of prompt A A . The proof is an induction over layers. At the input, positions outside S S have the same token in A A and B B , so their embeddings agree. Suppose that at the input of layer ℓ \ell every position outside S S agrees with the A A run. Attention at such a position reads its own query, which agrees, and keys and values from every position. Those outside S S agree by the hypothesis, and those inside S S have been replaced by the A A run’s. So the attention output agrees, the MLP, which acts position by position, agrees, and the residual stream at the output of layer ℓ \ell agrees. The query position is outside S S , so its final residual and its logits are those of A A . Nothing in the argument uses what the model has learned. It holds for a randomly initialised transformer and for any choice of S S , including a set of positions that carries no task information at all. A reviewer pointed this out to us and checked it on random transformers with and without query–key normalisation. The exact recovery in Section 3 therefore tells us only that the harness patches what it says it patches. The informative handoffs are the ones the argument does not cover: keys and values at the label tokens in a band of layers, values without keys, keys without values, and a changed sentence transmitted through the keys at positions where the input did not change. Appendix E Order effects and the many-shot fine-tuning test A model that has stored its demonstrations in a memory should not care about their order, and on average it does not: permuting the twelve demonstrations leaves the mean margin unchanged. Single prompts do move, by more than a nat on half of them, and the readers are the source of the movement. Their attention favours late slots, with a gradient of 0.5–0.85 nats of logit from the first slot to the last, so a prompt whose last matching demonstration sits near the query is read more strongly than one whose matching demonstrations come early. The brakes cancel this. With the 24 brakes knocked out the model prefers whichever label came last. At six demonstrations the brakes carry the anti-recency term outright, and at twelve they hold the model order-neutral against the readers’ pull. In SmolLM3 three heads carry most of the order term and can be named. We predicted that fine-tuning on many-shot prompts, where recency costs accuracy, would strengthen the brakes. It did not. We trained two LoRA adapters on Qwen3-4B (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 400 steps, adapters on every linear layer) on axes disjoint from the test battery, one on many-shot prompts and one on few-shot prompts, so that the two arms differ only in the number of demonstrations. After training, knocking out the 24 brakes raises the margin by + 1.32 +1.32 [+0.81, +1.82] in the many-shot arm and + 1.44 +1.44 [+0.86, +2.01] in the few-shot arm, so the brakes and their gain are unchanged. The readers moved instead: the cost of knocking them out rose about threefold under adaptation in both arms. Whatever sets the brakes’ strength, 400 steps of many-shot training is not it. Appendix F Emergence across OLMo-2 checkpoints Figure 21: The circuit assembles in order during training. Across OLMo-2 stage-1 checkpoints (grey: 1B; black: 7B), copying a repeated label is present from the earliest checkpoint. The null action, measured as withholding a label on unique-label prompts, appears in 1B between 315B and 839B tokens and is already present at 42B in 7B. Class-keyed retrieval, measured as a positive margin on unique-label prompts, arrives last, by 630B tokens in 7B and never in 1B. Thirty prompts per point. OLMo-2 releases intermediate checkpoints, which let us ask in what order the parts of the circuit appear. We ran the slotgate battery (two labels used twice against four labels used once, thirty prompts each) on six stage-1 checkpoints of OLMo-2 1B (10k, 50k, 150k, 400k, 900k and 1.9M steps; 21B to 4T tokens) and five of OLMo-2 7B (10k to 929k steps; 42B to 3.9T tokens), and read three measures at each. The null action comes second. In 1B, the share of unique-label prompts that still receive a label is 0.63, 0.73 and 0.60 at the first three checkpoints and 0.13, 0.03 and 0.17 at the last three, so withholding appears between 315B and 839B tokens; in 7B the share is already 0.17 at 42B tokens. Class-keyed retrieval comes last. The unique-prompt margin in 1B is negative at every checkpoint ( − 3.5 -3.5 to − 0.5 -0.5 ), and the model never does the task. In 7B it turns positive by 630B tokens ( + 0.86 +0.86 , accuracy 0.67; + 0.72 +0.72 at 3.9T). The order of copying, then the null action, then the readers is the one the dependencies require. blocks.en: The encoder bound is correlational. Every axis that failed to bind (parity, third letter, letter set, digit rules) is one that the model never represents linearly at the arrow, at any layer. Language, by contrast, becomes linear by layer 8 and binds weakly through layers 10–20, and topic, sentiment and implied meaning become linear by layer 13 and bind through layers 21–29. Adding the gate to a prompt that does not bind changes nothing.

This raises accuracy from 50% to 71% (question 38% → \to 58%, vowel 50% → \to 71%), while key-only, query-only and random directions stay within ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 , and writing into the wrong-class slots hurts. blocks.en: Let two prompts A A and B B have the same length and identical tokens except at a set of positions S S (here the label tokens). Run the model on B B and, at every layer, replace the keys and values computed at the positions in S S by those from the run on A A . We claim that every position outside S S then carries exactly its A A -run residual stream at every layer, so the logits at the query equal those of prompt A A .

blocks.en: The proof is an induction over layers. At the input, positions outside S S have the same token in A A and B B , so their embeddings agree. Suppose that at the input of layer ℓ \ell every position outside S S agrees with the A A run. Attention at such a position reads its own query, which agrees, and keys and values from every position. Those outside S S agree by the hypothesis, and those inside S S have been replaced by the A A run’s. So the attention output agrees, the MLP, which acts position by position, agrees, and the residual stream at the output of layer ℓ \ell agrees. The query position is outside S S , so its final residual and its logits are those of A A . Nothing in the argument uses what the model has learned. It holds for a randomly initialised transformer and for any choice of S S , including a set of positions that carries no task information at all. A reviewer pointed this out to us and checked it on random transformers with and without query–key normalisation.

blocks.en: The exact recovery in Section 3 therefore tells us only that the harness patches what it says it patches. The informative handoffs are the ones the argument does not cover: keys and values at the label tokens in a band of layers, values without keys, keys without values, and a changed sentence transmitted through the keys at positions where the input did not change.

blocks.en: A model that has stored its demonstrations in a memory should not care about their order, and on average it does not: permuting the twelve demonstrations leaves the mean margin unchanged. Single prompts do move, by more than a nat on half of them, and the readers are the source of the movement. Their attention favours late slots, with a gradient of 0.5–0.85 nats of logit from the first slot to the last, so a prompt whose last matching demonstration sits near the query is read more strongly than one whose matching demonstrations come early. The brakes cancel this. With the 24 brakes knocked out the model prefers whichever label came last. At six demonstrations the brakes carry the anti-recency term outright, and at twelve they hold the model order-neutral against the readers’ pull. In SmolLM3 three heads carry most of the order term and can be named.
blocks.zh: 在记忆中存储过其演示的模型不应该关心它们的顺序,而且平均来说它不会:穿透十二次演示的长度使平均比值保持不变. 单调音符确实在移动,超过一半的音符,读者是运动的源头. 他们的注意力倾向于后期的插槽,从第一个插槽到最后一个插槽的梯度为0.5-0.85纳特,因此,一个在查询附近进行最后一次匹配演示的提示比其匹配演示提前到来的一个更强烈。 刹车取消了这个。 24号刹车坏了 车型更喜欢最后的标签 在六场示威中,制动装置直接带有抗耐受性术语,在十二场中,制动装置对读者的拉力保持模式命令中立。 在SmolLM3中,三个头承载了命令术语的大部分,可以命名.

blocks.en: We predicted that fine-tuning on many-shot prompts, where recency costs accuracy, would strengthen the brakes. It did not. We trained two LoRA adapters on Qwen3-4B (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 400 steps, adapters on every linear layer) on axes disjoint from the test battery, one on many-shot prompts and one on few-shot prompts, so that the two arms differ only in the number of demonstrations. After training, knocking out the 24 brakes raises the margin by + 1.32 +1.32 [+0.81, +1.82] in the many-shot arm and + 1.44 +1.44 [+0.86, +2.01] in the few-shot arm, so the brakes and their gain are unchanged. The readers moved instead: the cost of knocking them out rose about threefold under adaptation in both arms. Whatever sets the brakes’ strength, 400 steps of many-shot training is not it.

blocks.en: OLMo-2 releases intermediate checkpoints, which let us ask in what order the parts of the circuit appear. We ran the slotgate battery (two labels used twice against four labels used once, thirty prompts each) on six stage-1 checkpoints of OLMo-2 1B (10k, 50k, 150k, 400k, 900k and 1.9M steps; 21B to 4T tokens) and five of OLMo-2 7B (10k to 929k steps; 42B to 3.9T tokens), and read three measures at each.
blocks.zh: OLMo-2放出中间检查站,让我们询问线路部分的出现顺序。 我们在OLMo-2 1B(10k,50k,150k,400k,900k和1.9M步;21B至4T令牌)和OLMo-2 7B(10k至929k步;42B至3.9T令牌)的6个一级检查站运行了槽门电池(两个标签两次对4个标签使用,各30个),并在每个检查站读3个措施。

blocks.en: Copying a repeated label is present from the first checkpoint in both models. On recurring prompts the label is the argmax at every checkpoint, and knocking out the sixteen duplicate-token heads removes the recurring margin from the first checkpoint on (1B at 10k steps: + 0.11 +0.11 to − 1.96 -1.96 ). The null action comes second. In 1B, the share of unique-label prompts that still receive a label is 0.63, 0.73 and 0.60 at the first three checkpoints and 0.13, 0.03 and 0.17 at the last three, so withholding appears between 315B and 839B tokens; in 7B the share is already 0.17 at 42B tokens. Class-keyed retrieval comes last. The unique-prompt margin in 1B is negative at every checkpoint ( − 3.5 -3.5 to − 0.5 -0.5 ), and the model never does the task. In 7B it turns positive by 630B tokens ( + 0.86 +0.86 , accuracy 0.67; + 0.72 +0.72 at 3.9T). The order of copying, then the null action, then the readers is the one the dependencies require.
blocks.zh: 从两个型号的第一个检查站复制一个重复的标签。 在重复的提示上,标签是每个检查站的标记,敲掉16个重复的记号头就可以消除第一个检查站的重复差值(1B,10k步:+0.11+0.11至−1.96-1.96 ) 。 无效的动作是第二。 在1B中,仍然收到标签的独家标签提示的分数在前3个检查站为0.63,0.73和0.60,在后3个检查站为0.13,0.03和0.17,所以扣号出现在315B和839B的符号之间;在7B中,该分数在42B的符号上已经是0.17. 类键检索最后。 1B中的独特瞬间差值在每个检查站都是负差(−3.5-3.5到−0.5-0.5),而模型从不完成任务. 在7B中,它通过630B令牌(+0.86+0.86,精度0.67;+0.72+0.72在3.9T)变为正数. 复制的顺序,然后是无效的动作,然后是读者是依赖性所需要的一个.

blocks.en: Two observations are specific to immature checkpoints. In trained 1B and in early 7B, knocking out the duplicate-token heads raises label emission on unique prompts (1B: 0.17 to 0.73), the opposite sign to Qwen; the trained 7B has Qwen’s sign. We also ran Pythia-1.4B across six checkpoints, but it is at chance on the task at every one and tells us nothing about the order.
blocks.zh: 有两点是针对不成熟的检查站的。 在训练的1B和早期的7B中,敲掉重复敲头会在独特的提示(1B:0.17至0.73)上提高标签排放,与Quen相反;训练的7B有Quen的标志. 我们还通过六个检查站运行了Pythia-1.4B,但每个检查站都有机会完成任务,而且没有告诉我们命令。
